a: Venirin kerasin ballulaot kechochavim barakia.

Tanu rabbanan: yeriot hattachtonot shel techelet veshel argaman veshel tolaat shani veshel shesh, veelyonot shel maase izzim. ugedola chachma shenneemra baelyonot yoter mimma shenneemra betachtonot, deillu betachtonot ketiv: "vechol ishsha chachmat lev beyadeha tavu", veillu beelyonot ketiv: "vechol hannashim asher nasa libban otana bechochma tavu et haizzim". vetanya mishshum rabbi nechemya: shatuf baizzim vetavuy min haizzim.

Shete gezuzetraot kulei. amar rav mishshum rabbi chiyyay: agalot — tachtehen uvenehen vetziddehen reshut harabbim. amar abbaye: ben agala laagala kimlo orech agala. vechamma orech agala — chamesh ammot. lema li? bearba ufalga saggi! ki hechi dela liddachku kerashim.
Amar rava: tzidde agala kimlo rochav agala. vechamma rochav agala — shete ammot umechetza. lema li? beammeta ufalga saggi! ki hechi dela lidaddu kerashim.

Ella dekayyma lan derech reshut harabbim shesh esre amma, anan degamrinan la mimmishkan — demishkan chamesre havay! ammeta yattira havay dahava kae ben levi, dechi mishtallefi kerashim hava naket lehu.
Mishna chuleyat habbor vehassela shehen gevohin asara verochban arbaa, hannotel mehen vehannoten al gabban — chayyayv, pachot mikken — patur.

Gemara lema li lemitne "chuleyat habbor vehassela"? litne "habbor vehassela"! mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: bor vechuleyatah mitztarfin laasara. tanya name hachi: bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urechava arbaa, en memallein hemenna beshabbat
b: Ella im ken asu lah mechitza gevoha asara tefachim, veen shotin hemenna beshabbat ella im ken hichnis lah rosho verubbo. uvor vechuleyatah mitztarfin laasara.

Bea minneh rav mardochay merava: ammud birshut harabbim gavoah asara verachav arbaa, vezarak venach al gabbav — mahu? mi amrinan: hare akira beissur, hare hannacha beissur. o dilma: kevan demimmekom petur kaatya — la.
Amar leh: matnitin hi. ata shayyleh lerav yosef, amar leh: matnitin hi. ata shayyleh leabbaye, amar leh: matnitin hi. amar lehu: kullechu berukka dahadade tafitu.
Amaru leh: veat la tisbera? vehatnan: hannotel mehen venoten al gabban — chayyayv! amar lehu: dilma matnitin bemachat.
Machat name i efshar dela middalya pureta! deit leh muresha. i name, deramya bacharitza.

Amar rav meyasha, bae rabbi yochanan: kotel birshut harabbim gavoah asara veeno rachav arba umukkaf lecharmelit vaasao reshut hayyachid, vezarak venach al gabbav, mahu? mi amrinan kevan deeno rachav arba — mekom petur hu, o dilma: kevan daasao reshut hayyachid — keman demalya damya.

Amar ulla: kal vachomer, laacherim ose mechitza, leatzmo lo kol shekken?! ittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar ashe amar rav, vechen amar rabbi yitzchak amar rabbi yochanan: kotel birshut harabbim gavoah asara veeno rachav arba umukkaf lecharmelit vaasao reshut hayyachid, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv. laacherim ose mechitza, leatzmo lo kol shekken?!

Bae rabbi yochanan bor tisha veakar mimmenna chuleya vehishlimah laasara — mahu? akirat chefetz vaasiyyayt mechitza bahade hadade (kaatu), michayyayv o la michayyayv? veim timtze lomar kevan dela have mechitza asara meikkara la michayyayv: bor asara venatan letochah chuleya umiatah, mahu? hannachat chefetz vesilluk mechitza bahade hadade (kaatu), michayyayv o la michayyayv.

Tifshot leh middideh, datnan: hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim — kezorek baavir. lematta measara — kezorek baaretz, vehazzorek baaretz arba ammot — chayyayv. vehavenan ba: veha la nach?
Veamar rabbi yochanan: bidvela shemena shaninu. veammay? ha ka memaet mearba ammot.
Hatam la mevattel la. hacha — mevattel la.
Bae rava: zarak daf venach al gabbe yetedot, mahu? may kamibbaya leh — hannachat chefetz vaasiyyayt mechitza bahade hadade (kaatu)? hayeynu derabbi yochanan!

Ki kamibbaya leh lerava kegon dezarak daf vechefetz al gabbav, may? kevan devahade hadade kaatu kehannachat chefetz vaasiyyayt mechitza dame, o dilma: kevan dela efshar dela middele pureta vahadar nayaych, kaasiyyayt mechitza vehannachat chefetz dame. teku.
Amar rava: peshita li mayim al gabbe mayim — hayeynu hannachatan. egoz al gabbe mayim —

a: Lav hayeynu hannachatan. bae rava: egoz bichli ucheli tzaf al gabbe mayim — mahu? mi amrinan batar egoz azlinan, veha nayaych, o dilma batar keli azlinan, veha la nayaych. teku.

Shemen al gabbe yayin, machaloket rabbi yochanan ben nuri verabbanan. ditnan: shemen shetztzaf al gabbe yayin, venaga tevul yom bashshemen — lo pasal ella shemen. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shenehem chibbur ze laze.

Amar abbaye: bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urechava shemona, vezarak letochah machtzelet — chayyayv. chillekah bemachtzelet — patur. leabbaye difshita leh demachtzelet mevattela mechitzta — kol shekken chuleya dimvattela mechitzta. lerabbi yochanan demibbaya leh chuleya, machtzelet peshita dela mevattela mechitzta.

Veamar abbaye: bor birshut harabbim amukka asara urechava arbaa melea mayim, vezarak letochah — chayyayv. melea perot, vezarak letochah — patur, may tama? — mayim la mevatteli mechitzta, perot mevatteli mechitzta. tanya name hachi: hazzorek min hayyam leisratya umin haisratya layyam — patur. rabbi shimon omer: im yesh bimkom shezzarak amok asara verachav arbaa — chayyayv.
Mishna hazzorek arba ammot bakkotel, lemala measara tefachim — kezorek baavir. lematta measara tefachim — kezorek baaretz. hazzorek baaretz arba ammot — chayyayv.
Gemara veha la nach? amar rabbi yochanan: bidvela shemena shaninu.

Amar rav yehuda, amar rav, amar rabbi chiyyay: zarak lemala measara, vehalcha venacha bechor kol shehu, banu lemachloket rabbi meir verabbanan. lerabbi meir deamar chokkin lehashelim — michayyayv. lerabbanan deamri en chokkin lehashelim — la michayyayv. tanya name hachi: zarak lemala measara, vehalcha venacha bechor kol shehu — rabbi meir mechayyev vachachamim potrin.

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv. tanya name hachi: mavoy sheshshava letocho, venaasa midron lirshut harabbim, o shava lirshut harabbim venaasa midron letocho — oto mavoy eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora. rabbi chanina ben gamliel omer: tel hammitlakket asara mittoch arba, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv.
Mishna zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot — patur. chutz learba ammot venitgalgel letoch arba ammot — chayyayv.

Gemara veha la nach? amar rabbi yochanan: vehu shennach al gabbe mashshehu. tanya name hachi: zarak chutz learba ammot udechafattu haruach vehichnisattu, veaf al pi shechazra vehotziattu — patur. achazattu haruach mashshehu, af al pi shechazra vehichnisattu — chayyayv.
Amar rava: toch shelosha lerabbanan tzarich hannacha al gabbe mashshehu. yatev marimar vekaamar la leha shemata. amar leh ravina lemarimar:
b: Lav hayeynu matnitin, veamar rabbi yochanan: vehu shennach al gabbe mashshehu. amar leh: mitgalgel kaamrat — mitgalgel en sofo lanuach, aval hay kevan desofo lanuach, af al gav dela nach — keman denach dame, ka mashma lan.

Mishna hazzorek bayyam arba ammot — patur. im haya rekak mayim, ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek letocho arba ammot — chayyayv. vechamma hu rekak mayim — pachot measara tefachim. rekak mayim ureshut harabbim mehallechet bo, hazzorek betocho arba ammot — chayyayv.

Gemara amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: bishlama "hilluch" "hilluch" tere zimne, ha ka mashma lan: hilluch al yede haddechak — shemeh hilluch, tashmish al yede haddechak — la shemeh tashmish. ella "rekak" "rekak" tere zimne lema li? chad bimot hachamma vechad bimot haggeshamim. utzerichi. dei tena chada, hava amena hane mille bimot hachamma, daavidi inashe dimsaggi leokore nafshayyhu, aval bimot haggeshamim — la. vei ashmeinan bimot haggeshamim, dechevan demittannefi la ichpat lehu, aval bimot hachamma — la.
Abbaye amar: itzterich, salka datach amena hane mille hecha dela have arba ammot, aval hecha dehave arba ammot — akkofe makkefi leh.

Rav ashe amar: itzterich, salka datach amena hane mille hecha dahavay arbaa, aval hecha dela havay arbaa — mifsa pasi leh. veazda rav ashe letameh, deamar rav ashe: hay man dezarek venach aggudda degamla — michayyayv, shehare rabbim bokin bo.

Mishna hazzorek min hayyam layyabbasha, umin hayyabbasha layyam, umin hayyam lassefina, umin hassefina layyam, umin hassefina lachavertah — patur. sefinot keshurot zo bazo — metaltelin mizzo lazo. im enan keshurot, af al pi shemmukkafot — en metaltelin mizzo lazo.
Gemara ittemar: sefina, rav huna amar: motziin hemenna ziz kol shehu umemalle. rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri: ose mekom arbaa umemalle.
Rav huna amar motzi hemenna ziz kol shehu umemalle, kasavar karmelit meara mashchinan veavvera mekom petur hu, uvedin hu deziz name la live, ella — ki hechi delehve leh hekkera.
Rav chisda verabba bar rav huna amri ose mekom arbaa umemalle, kasavri karmelit missefat mayya mashchinan — mayya ara semichta, i la aved mekom arbaa — ka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid.

Amar leh rav nachman lerabba bar avu: ulerav huna deamar motzi hemenna ziz kol shehu umemalle, zimnin delekka asara, veka metaltel mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid! amar leh: gamrinan deen sefina mehallechet befachot measara. veha muresha it la! amar rav safra: gashoshe azli kamma.

Amar leh rav nachman bar yitzchak lerav chiyyay bar avin: lerav chisda ulerabba bar rav huna deamri ose mekom arbaa umemalle, shofchin dideh hechi shade lehu? vechi tema deshade lehu beoto makom — meisi leh. deshade lehu addufna disfina. veha ikka kocho! kocho becharmelit la gezaru. umena temra? detanya: sefina en metaltelin lo mittochah layyam velo min hayyam letochah,

a: Rabbi yehuda omer: amukka asara, veen gevoha asara — mittaltelin mittochah layyam, aval lo min hayyam letochah. may shena min hayyam letochah dela — deka metaltelin mikkarmelit lirshut hayyachid, mittochah layyam — name kamtaltel mershut hayyachid lecharmelit! ella lav achuddah. ushema minna kocho becharmelit la gezaru. shema minna.

Amar rav huna: hane bitziyyata demeshan en metaltelin bahen ella bearba [ammot]. vela amaran ella sheen befachot mishshelosha arbaa, aval yesh befachot mishshelosha arbaa — let lan ba. vei melanhu kene veurebane — let lan ba.

Matkef la rav nachman, velema gud achet mechitzata! mi la tanya, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: naatz kane birshut harabbim uverosho teraskal, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv. alma amrinan gud achet mechitzata. hacha name nema gud achet mechitzata!

Matkef la rav yosef: vela shemia lehu leha deamar rav yehuda amar rav, umatu bah mishshum rabbi chiyyay, vetane ala: vachachamim potrin. amar leh abbaye: veat la tisbera? vehatanya: ammud birshut harabbim gavoah asara verachav arbaa, veen beikkaro arbaa, veyesh bakkatzar shello shelosha, vezarak venach al gabbav — chayyayv. alma amrinan: gud achet mechitzata. hacha name: gud achet mechitzata.

Midde irya?! hatam havya la mechitza shehaggedayim bokin bah. hacha havya la mechitza sheen haggedayim bokin bah. amar leh rav acha bereh derav acha lerav ashe: gabbe sefina name, ha ikka bekiat dagim! amar leh: bekiat dagim lo shemah bekia. umena temra? — diva minneh rabbi tavla merav: mechitza teluya mahu shettattir bechureba? vaamar leh: en mechitza teluya matteret
b: Ella bemayim, kal hu shehekellu chachamim bemayim. veammay, ha ikka bekiat dagim? ella shema minna — bekiat dagim lo shemah bekia.
Sefinot keshurot kulei. peshita! amar rava: lo nitzrecha ella lehattir bitztzit shebbenehen.

Amar leh rav safra: moshe, shappir kaamrat?! "metaltelin mizzo lazo" tenan! ella amar rav safra: lo nitzrecha ella learev uletaltel mizzo lazo, vechidtanya: sefinot keshurot zo bazo — mearvin umetaltelin mizzo lazo. nifseku — neesru. chazru veniksheru, ben shoggin uven mezidin ben anusin ben mutein — chazru lehetteran harishon.

Vechen machtzalot happerusot lirshut harabbim — mearvin umetaltelin mizzo lazo. niglelu — neseru. chazru venifresu, ben shoggin ben mezidin ben anusin uven mutein — chazru lehetteran harishon, shekkol mechitza shennaaset bashshabbat, ben beshogeg ben bemezid — shemah mechitza.
Ini?! vehaamar rav nachman: lo shanu ella lizrok, aval letaltel asur! ki ittemar derav nachman — ammezid ittemar.
Amar shemuel: vaafillu keshurot bechut hassarbal. hechi dame? i deyachol lehaamidan — peshita. i deen yachol lehaamidan — ammay?

Leolam deyachol lehaamidan. ushemuel leappoke middenafsheh kaate. ditnan: kesharah bedavar hammaamidah — mevi lah tumea. bedavar sheen maamidah — en mevi lah tumea. veamar shemuel: vehu shekkeshura beshalshelet shel barzel.
Leinyan tumea hu, dichtiv: "bachalal cherev" — cherev hare hu kechalal. (in) aval leinyan shabbat, kevan deyachol lehaamidah, hekker bealma hu — afillu bechut hassarbal.

a: Mishna hazzorek, venizkar meachar sheyyatzta miyyado, kelatah acher, kelatah kelev o shennisrefa — patur. zarak laasot chabbura, ben beadam uven babbehema, venizkar ad shello naaset chabbura — patur. ze hakkelal: kol chayyayve chattaot — enan chayyayvin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga. techillatan shegaga vesofan zadon, techillatan zadon vesofan shegaga — peturin, ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga.
Gemara ha nacha — chayyayv? vahalo nizkar, utenan: kol chayyayve chattaot enan chayyayvin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga?! amar rav kahana: sefa atan lelachta umitna.

Lachta umitna ogdo beyado hu! kegon shennitkavven laasot chabbura. ha name tenena: hazzorek laasot chabbura, ben baadam ben babbehema, venizkar ad shello naaset chabbura — patur! ella amar rava: bemaavir.
Veha "ze hakkelal" dekatane, azzerika katane. ella amar rava, tarte katane: hazzorek venizkar meachar sheyyatzta miyyado, i name lo nizkar ukelatah acher o kelatah kelev o shennisrefa — patur.

Rav ashe amar: chassore mechassera, vehachi katane: hazzorek venizkar meachar sheyyatzta miyyado, kelatah acher o kelatah kelev o shennisrefa — patur. ha nacha — chayyayv. bamme devarim amurim — shechazar veshachach, aval lo chazar veshachach — patur, shekkol chayyayve chattaot enan chayyayvin ad shettehe techillatan vesofan shegaga.
Ze hakkelal: kol chayyayve chattaot kulei. ittemar: shete ammot beshogeg, shete ammot bemezid, shete ammot beshogeg — rabba amar: patur. rava amar: chayyayv.
Rabba amar patur, afillu lerabban gamliel deamar en yedia lachatzi shiur, hatam hu dechi ka gamar shiura — beshogeg ka gamar, aval hacha divmezid — la.
Uvemay? i bezorek — shogeg hu! ella bemaavir.
Rava amar chayyayv, vaafillu lerabbanan deamri yesh yedia lachatzi shiur, hatam hu divyado, aval hacha deen beyado — la. uvemay? i bemaavir — hare beyado! veella bezorek.
Amar rabba: zarak venacha befi hakkelev o befi hakkivshan — chayyayv. vehaanan tenan: kelatah acher o kelatah hakkelev o shennisrefa — patur! hatam dela mechavven, hacha deka mechavven.
Amar rav bivi bar abbaye, af anan name tenena: yesh ochel achila achat vechayyayv aleha arba chattaot veasham echad. hattame sheachal chelev, vehu notar min hammukedashin, beyom hakkippurim.

Rabbi meir omer: af im hayta shabbat vehotzio [befiv] — chayyayv. amru lo: eno min hashshem. veammay? ha en derech hotzaa bechach! ella: kevan deka mikkavven — machshavto meshavveya leh makom. hacha name, kevan deka mikkavven — machshavto meshavveya leh makom.
Haderan alach hazzorek
b: Mishna habbone, kamma yivne vihe chayyayv? habbone kol shehu, vehamesattet vehammakke bappattish uvemaatzad, hakkodeach kol shehu — chayyayv. ze hakkelal: kol haose melacha, umelachto mitkayyemet bashshabbat — chayyayv. vechen rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af hammakke bekurenas al hassaddan bishat melacha — chayyayv, mippene shehu kimtakken melacha.

Gemara kol shehu lemay chazya? amar rabbi yirmeya: shekken ani chofer gumma lehatzenia bah perutotav. dichvota gabbe mishkan, shekken tofre yeriot chofrin gumma lehatzenia bah machatehen. abbaye amar: kevan demishshattechi la avdi hachi. ella, shekken ani ose pitpute kira ketanna lishpot aleha kedera ketanna. dichvota gabbe mishkan, mevashshele sammanin litzboa yeriot shechasra melachtan, osin pitpute kira ketanna lishpot aleha yora ketanna.

Rav acha bar yaakov amar: en aniyyut bimkom ashirut. ella, shekken baal habbayit sheyyesh lo nekev bevirato vesotmo, dichvota gabbe mishkan, shekken keresh shennafla bo darna — mattif letochah avar vesotmo.
Amar shemuel: hametzadded et haeven — chayyayv. metivi, echad noten et haeven veechad noten et hattit — hannoten et hattit chayyayv!

Velitamaych, ema sefa, rabbi yose omer: vaafillu heela vehinniach al gabbe dimos shel avanim — chayyayv! ella telata binyayne havu: tatta, metziaa, veillaa. tatta bae tzaddode veafra. metzia bae name tina. illaa behannacha bealma.

Vehamesattet. mesattet mishshum may michayyayv? rav amar: mishshum bone, ushemuel amar: mishshum makke bappattish. haose nekev belul shel tarnegolim, rav amar: mishshum bone, ushemuel amar: mishshum makke bappattish. ayyel shufeta bekofina demara, rav amar: mishshum bone, ushemuel amar: mishshum makke bappattish.

Utzericha, dei ashmeinan kammayyta — behahi kaamar rav, mishshum dederech binyan bechach. aval ose nekev belul shel tarnegolim, deen derech binyan bechach — ema mode leh lishmuel. vei ashmeinan beha — beha kaamar rav, mishshum dedame levinyan, deavdeh leavvera,
Aval shufeta bekofina demara deen derech binyan bechach — ema mode leh lishmuel. vei ashmeinan beha, beha kaamar shemuel, aval behanach tarte — ema mode leh lerav, tzericha.

Bea minneh rav natan bar oshaya merabbi yochanan: mesattet mishshum may michayyayv? achvi leh bideh mishshum makke bappattish. vehaanan tenan: hamesattet vehammakke bappattish! ema: hamesattet hammakke bappattish.
Ta shema:

a: Hakkodeach kol shehu — chayyayv. bishlama lerav — mechze keman dechar chorta levinyayna, ella lishmuel — lav gemar melacha hu! hacha bemay askinan — devazeh beramtza defarzela veshavkeh begavvevy, dehayynu gemar melacha.
Ze hakkelal. "ze hakkelal" leetuye may? leetuye dechak kefiza bekabba.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: hammakke bekurenas al hassaddan kulei. may kaaved? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: mippene shemammen et yado. kashu bah bene rachava: ella meatta, chaza ummanuta beshabbeta ugemar, hachi name demichayyayv? ella abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: shekken meraddede tasse mishkan osin ken. tanya name hachi, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af hammakke bekurenas al hassaddan bishat melacha — chayyayv, shekken meraddede tasse mishkan osin ken.

Mishna hachoresh kol shehu, hamenakkesh vehamekarsem vehamezared kol shehu — chayyayv. hamelakket etzim, im letakken — kol shehen, im lehessek — kede levashshel betza kalla. hamelakket asavim, im letakken — kol shehu, im livhema — kimlo fi haggedi.
Gemara lemay chaze? chaze levizra dekara. dichvota gabbe mishkan, shekken rauy lekelach echad shel sammanin.

Hamenakkesh vehamekarsem vehamezared. tanu rabbanan: hattolesh uleshin vehamezared zeradim, im laachila — kigrogeret. im livhema — kimlo fi haggedi. im lehessek — kede levashshel betza kalla. im leyaypot et hakkarka — kol shehen.

Attu kullehu la leyappot et hakkarka ninhu? rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: baagam shanu. abbaye amar: afillu tema besade delav agam, uchegon dela kamikkavven. veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon, bifsik resheh vela yemut"! la tzericha, dekaaved beara dechavreh.

Mishna hakkotev shete otiyyot, ben bimino ben bismolo, ben mishshem echad ben mishshene shemot ben mishte sammaniyyot, bechol lashon — chayyayv. amar rabbi yose: lo chiyyeyvu shete otiyyot ella mishshum roshem, shekkach kotvin al karshe hammishkan leda ezo ben zugo. amar rabbi yehuda: matzinu shem katan mishshem gadol — "shem" mishshimon umishshemuel, "noach" minnachor, "dan" middaniel, "gad" miggaddiel.

Gemara bishlama ayyamin lichayyayv mishshum dederech ketiva bechach, ella assemol ammay? ha en derech ketiva bechach! amar rabbi yirmeya: beitter yad shanu. veteheve semol dideh keyamin dechulle alma, veassemol lichayyayv, ayyamin la lichayyayv! ella amar abbaye: besholet bishte yadav.
Rav yaakov bere devat yaakov amar: ha manni — rabbi yose hi, daamar lo chiyyeyvu shete otiyyot ella mishshum roshem. veha middesefa rabbi yose hi, resha lav rabbi yose! kullah rabbi yose hi.
Amar rabbi yehuda, matzinu. ella rabbi yehuda shete otiyyot vehen shene shemot hu dimchayyev, shete otiyyot vehen shem echad — la mechayyev?
Vehatanya: "veasa" — achat. yachol ad sheyyichtov kol hashshem, vead sheyyeerog kol habbeged, vead sheyyaase kol hannafa — talmud lomar: "meachat".
I "meachat", yachol afillu lo katav ella ot achat, velo arag ella chut echad, velo asa ella bayit echad bannafa,
b: Talmud lomar: "achat". ha ketzad, eno chayyayv ad sheyyichtov shem katan mishshem gadol — "shem" mishshimon umishshemuel, "noach" minnachor, "dan" middaniel, "gad" miggaddiel. rabbi yehuda omer: afillu lo katav ella shete otiyyot vehen shem echad — chayyayv, kegon: "shesh" "tet", "rar", "gag", "chach".

Amar rabbi yose: vechi mishshum kotev hu chayyayv?! vahalo eno chayyayv ella mishshum roshem, shekken roshmin al karshe hammishkan leda ezo hi ben zugo. lefichach, sarat serita achat al shene nesarin, o shete seritot al neser echad — chayyayv.

Rabbi shimon omer: "veasa achat", yachol ad sheyyichtov et kol hashshem, ad sheyyeerog kol habbeged, ad sheyyaase et kol hannafa — talmud lomar: "meachat". i "meachat", yachol afillu lo katav ella ot achat, vaafillu lo arag ella chut echad, vaafillu lo asa ella bayit echad bannafa — talmud lomar: "achat". ha ketzad? eno chayyayv ad sheyyaase melacha shekkayyotze bah mitkayyemet.
Rabbi yose omer: "veasa achat" "veasa henna", peamim shechayyayv achat al kullan, ufeamim shechayyayv al kol achat veachat.

Katane miha: rabbi yehuda omer afillu lo katav ella shete otiyyot vehen shem echad — chayyayv. la kashya: ha dideh, ha derabbeh. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabban gamliel: afillu lo katav ella shete otiyyot vehen shem echad — chayyayv, kegon "shesh", "tet", "rar", "gag", "chach".

Rabbi shimon hayeynu tanna kamma? vechi tema alef alef daaazzercha" ikka benayyhu, detanna kamma savar alef alef daaazzercha" la michayyayv, verabbi shimon savar kevan deiteh biglatore bealma — chayyayv, lememra derabbi shimon lechumera?

Vehatanya: hakkodeach kol shehu chayyayv, hamegarer kol shehu, hameabbed kol shehu, hatztzar bichli tzura kol shehu. rabbi shimon omer: ad sheyyikdach et kullo, ad sheyyigror et kullo, ad sheyyeabbed et kullo, ad sheyyatzur kullo.

Ella, rabbi shimon ha ata leashmoinan, ad sheyyichtov et hashshem kullo. umi matzet amrat hachi? vehatanya, rabbi shimon omer: "veasa achat", yachol ad sheyyichtov et hashshem kullo — talmud lomar: "meachat"! taretz veema hachi: yachol ad sheyyichtov et happasuk kullo — talmud lomar: "meachat".
Rabbi yose omer: "veasa achat" "veasa henna" — peamim shechayyayv achat al kullan, ufeamim shechayyayv al kol achat veachat.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: may tama derabbi yose "achat" "meachat", "henna" "mehenna", achat shehi "henna", vehenna" shehi achat.
"Achat" — "shimon", "meachat" — "shem" mishshimon". "henna" — avot, "mehenna" — toladot. achat shehi henna — zedon shabbat veshiggat melachot. henna shehi achat — shiggat shabbat uzedon melachot.
Amar rabbi yehuda: matzinu shem katan mishshem gadol. mi dame? mem deshem" satum, mem deshimon" patuach! amar rav chisda: zot omeret satum vaasao patuach — kasher.

Metivi: "uchetavtam" — shettehe ketiva tamma, shello yichtov alfin ayynin, ayynin alfin. betin kafin, kafin betin. gammin tzadin, tzadin gammin. daltin reshin, reshin daltin. hehin chetin, chetin hehin. vavin yodin, yodin vavin. zayynin nunin, nunin zayynin. tetin pefin, pefin tetin.

Kefufin peshutin, peshutin kefufin. memin samchin, samchin memin. setumin petuchin, petuchin setumin. parasha petucha lo yaasenna setuma, setuma lo yaasenna petucha. ketavah keshira, o shekkatav et hashshira kayyotze vah, o shekkatav shello bidyo, o shekkatav et haazkarot bezahav — hare ellu yigganzu.

Hu deamar ki hay tanna, detanya, rabbi yehuda ben betira omer: neemar bashsheni "veniskehem". bashshishshi "unesacheha", bashshevii "kemishpatam", hare mem yod mem — "mayim", mikkan remez lenissuch mayim min hattora.
Umiddefatuach vaasao satum — kasher, satum name satum vaasao patuach — kasher.
Mi dame? patuach vaasao satum —

a: Alloye ka mealle leh, deamar rav chisda: mem vesamech shebballuchot benes hayu omdin. ella satum vaasao patuach — garoe ka megara leh, deamar rabbi yirmeya, veittema rabbi chiyyay bar abba: mantzefach tzofim amarum.

Vetisbera?! vehachtiv: "elle hammitzvot" — sheen hannavi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta! ella miAdonai havay, midda la hava yadin he beemtza teva he besof teva, vaato tzofim takkeninhu. veakkatti "elle hammitzvot" — sheen hannavi rashshay lechaddesh davar meatta! ella, shechachum vechazru veyissedum.

Gufa, amar rav chisda: mem vesamech shebballuchot benes hayu omdin. veamar rav chisda: ketav shebballuchot nikra mibbifnim venikra mibbachutz, kegon: "nevuv" — "baveban", "rahav" — "bahar", "saru" — "vares".

Amri leh rabbanan lerabbi yehoshua ben levi: ato dardeke haiddana leve midresha vaamaru mille daafillu bime yehoshua bin nun la ittemar kevotayyhu: alef bet — alaf bina. gimel dalet — gemol dallim. may tama peshuta kareh degimel legabbe dalet — shekken darko shel gomel chasadim larutz achar dallim. umay tama peshuta kareh dedalet legabbay gimel — delaymtzeya leh nafsheh. umay tama mehaddar appeh dedalet miggimel — delitten leh betzina, ki hechi dela likkesif minneh.

11 — Ze shemo shel hakkadosh baruch hu. 15 19 50 — veim atta ose ken, hakkadosh baruch hu zan otcha, vechan otcha, umetiv lecha, venoten lecha yerushsha, vekosher lecha keter laolam habba. mem petucha, mem setuma — maamar patuach, maamar satum. nun kefufa, nun peshuta — neeman kafuf, neeman pashut.

130 — Semoch aniyyim. lishshana acharina: simanin ase battora ukene otah. 80 kefufa, 80 peshuta — pe patuach, pe satum. tzadi kefufa vetzadi peshuta — tzaddik kafuf, tzaddik pashut. hayeynu: neeman kafuf, neeman pashut! hosif lecha hakkatuv kefifa al kefifato, mikkan shennittena hattora bimnod rosh.

Kuf — kadosh. resh — rasha. may tama mehaddar appeh dekuf meresh — amar hakkadosh baruch hu: en ani yachol lehistakkel barasha. umay tama mehaddar tageh dekuf legabbe resh — amar hakkadosh baruch hu: im chozer bo ani kosher lo keter kemoti. umay tama kareh dekuf talya — dei hadar beh, liayyel.
Veleul behach! mesayyay leh leresh lakish, deamar resh lakish: may dichtiv "im lalletzim hu yalitz velaanavim yitten chen"? ba litamme — potchin lo, ba littaher — mesayyeyim oto.

Shin — sheker. tav — emet. may tama sheker mekarvan milleh, emet merachaka milleh? — shikra shechiach, kusheta la shechiach. umay tama shikra achada kareh kae, veemet melabban labbone — kusheta kae, shikra la kae.

Aval middat tzaddikim: 401 302 — im atta bosh. 203 104 — im atta ose ken, gur bedok. 95 86 — chatzitza have bencha laaf. 77 68 59 — veen atta mizdazea min hassatan. 50 50 — amar [sar shel] gehinnam lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, layyam kol.

Amar hakkadosh baruch hu: 69 81 93 — ani chas alehem mippene shebbaatu begif: 114 — dakkim hem, kenim hem, tzaddikim hem. 135 — en lecha chelek bahen. 303 700 — amar gehinnam lefanav: ribbono shel olam, mari, zuneni mizzaro shel shet.

Amar lo: 31 42 53 64 — lehechan olichen, legan hadas. 75 86 — amar gehinnam lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, ayef anochi. 97 108 — hallalu zaro shel yitzchak. 209 310 420 — tor yesh li kittot kittot shel ummot haolam sheani noten lecha.
b: Mishna hakkotev shete otiyyot behelem echad — chayyayv. katav bidyo besam besikra bekomos uvekankantom uvechol davar shehu roshem. al shene kotle zaviyyot veal shene luche finkas vehen nehegin ze im ze — chayyayv. hakkotev al besaro — chayyayv. hamesaret al besaro — rabbi eliezer mechayyev chattat vachachamim potrin.

Katav bemashkin beme perot, baavak derachim baavak hassofrim uvechol davar sheeno mitkayyem — patur. leachar yado beraglo befiv uvemarpeko, katav ot achat samuch lakketav, uchetav al gabbe ketav, nitkavvevn lichtov chet vechatav shete zayynin, achat baaretz veachat bakkora, katav al shene kotle habbayit, al shene dappe finkas veen nehegin ze im ze — patur. katav ot achat notarikon — rabbi yehoshua ben betera mechayyev vachachamim potrin.
Gemara deyo — deyota. sam — samma. sikra — amar rabba bar bar chana: sekarta shemah. komos — koma. kankantom — amar rabba bar bar chana amar shemuel: charta deushekafe.
Uvechol davar shehu roshem. leetoye may? leetoye ha detane rabbi chananya: ketavo beme tarya veaftza — kasher. tane rabbi chiyyay: ketavo baavar bishchor uveshichor — kasher.

Hamesaret al besaro. tanya, amar lahen rabbi eliezer lachachamim: vahalo ben satada hotzi keshafim mimmitzrayim bisrita sheal besaro? amru lo: shote haya, veen meviin reaya min hashshotim. "ben satada"? ben pandira hu! amar rav chisda: baal "satada", boel "pandira". baal pappus ben yehuda hu? ella immo "satada". immo miryam megaddela sear neshayya havay? ella kidamri befumebdita: setat da mibbala.
Katav ot achat samuch lakketav. man tanna? amar rava bar rav huna: dela kerabbi eliezer, dei rabbi eliezer, haamar: achat al haarig — chayyayv.

Ketav al gabbe ketav. man tanna? amar rav chisda: dela kerabbi yehuda. detanya: hare shehaya tzarich lichtov et hashshem, venitkavven lichtov "yehuda", vetaa velo hetil bo dalet — maavir alav kulemos umekaddesho, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim: en hashshem min hammuvechar.

Tana: katav ot achat vehishlimah lesefer, arag chut echad vehishlimo leveged — chayyayv. man tanna? amar rava bar rav huna: rabbi eliezer hi, deamar achat al haarig — chayyayv. rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbanan, lehashelim shane.

Amar rabbi amme: katav ot achat bitverya veachat betzippori — chayyayv, ketiva hi, ella shemchussar keriva. vehatnan: katav al shene kotle habbayit veal shene dappe finkas veen nehegin ze im ze — patur! hatam mechussar maase dikriva, hacha lo mechussar maase dikriva.

Tana: higgiah ot achat — chayyayv. hasheta katav ot achat — patur, higgiah ot achat chayyayv?! amar rav sheshet: hacha bemay askinan — kegon shennetalo legaggo shel chet vaasao shene zayynin. rava amar: kegon shennetalo letago shel dalet vaasao resh.
Tana: nitkavven lichtov ot achat

a: Vealu beyado shetayim — chayyayv. vehatnan patur! la kashya: ha devae zayyone, ha dela bae zayyone.

Katav ot achat notarikon, rabbi yehoshua ben betira mechayyev vachachamim potrin. amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose ben zimra: minnayin lilshon notarikon min hattora, shenneemar: "ki av hamon goyim netatticha" — av netatticha laummot, bachur netatticha baummot, hamon chaviv netatticha baummot, melech netatticha laummot, vatik netatticha baummot, neeman netatticha laummot.
Rabbi yochanan dideh amar: "anochi", notarikon: ana nafshi ketavit yehavit. rabbanan amri: amira neima ketiva yehiva. ikka deamri "anochi" lemafrea: yehiva ketiva neemanin amareha.

Deve rabbi natan amri: "ki yarat hadderech lenegdi" — yara, raata, natta. deve rabbi yishmael tana: "karmel" — kar male. rav acha bar yaakov amar: "vehu killani kelala nimretzet", notarikon: noef hu, moavi hu, rotzeach hu, tzorer hu, toeva hu.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: "ma nedabber uma nitztaddak" — nechonim anachnu, tzaddikim anachnu, tehorim anachnu, dakkim anachnu, kedoshim anachnu.
Mishna hakkotev shete otiyyot bishte helemot, achat shacharit veachat ben haarbayim, rabban gamliel mechayyev vachachamim potrin.
Gemara bemay kamippalgi? rabban gamliel savar en yedia lachatzi shiur, verabbanan savri yesh yedia lachatzi shiur.
Haderan alach habbone

Mishna rabbi eliezer omer: haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veachat al haarig — chayyayv. vachachamim omrim: ben battechilla ben bassof — shiuro shene chutin. haose shete vatte nirin bannirayim, bakkeros, bannafa, bakkevara uvassal — chayyayv. vehattofer shete tefirot, vehakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot.

Gemara ki ata rabbi yitzchak tane: "shetayim". vehaanan tenan: "shalosh"! la kashya: ha beallime, ha bekattine. amri la lehay gisa, veamri la lehay gisa. amri la lehay gisa: allime — telata la satri, tere satri. kattine — tere name la satri. veamri la lehay gisa: kattine — telata yedii, tere la yedii. allime — tere name yedii.

Tanya: haoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veechad al haarig — chayyayv. vachachamim omrim: ben battechilla ben bassof — shiuran shene chutin. uvassafa — shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin. ha lema ze dome? leoreg tziltzol katan, shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin. vehaoreg shelosha chutin battechilla veechad al haarig chayyayv, setama kerabbi eliezer.

Tanya iddach: haoreg shene chutin al haggas? veal haimra — chayyayv. rabbi eliezer omer: afillu echad. uvassafa, shene chutin berochav shelosha vatte nirin — chayyayv. ha lema ze dome — leoreg tziltzol katan shene chutin al rochav shelosha batte nirin: vehaoreg shene chutin al haggas veal haimra chayyayv — setama kerabbanan.
Haose shene vatte nirin kulei. may bannirayim? amar abbaye: tarte bevat nira vachada benira. bekeros. may bekeros? amar rav: metzovita.

Vehattofer shete tefirot. ha tenena baavot melachot: vehattofer shete tefirot! mishshum dekavae lemitna sefa: "vehakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot", katane name hattofer. vehakkorea. ha name tenena baavot melachot! ella mishshum dekavae lemitne sefa, hakkorea bachamato veal meto, mishshum hachi katane [hattofer shete tefirot].
Vehakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot. hechi mashkachat la?
b: Deavda ki chista.

Mishna hakkorea bachamato veal meto, vechol hamekalkelin — peturin. vehamekalkel al menat letakken — shiuro kimtakken. shiur hamelabben vehamenappetz vehatztzovea vehattove — kimlo rochav hassit kaful, vehaoreg shene chutin — shiuro kimlo hassit.
Gemara ureminhu: hakkorea bachamato uveevlo veal meto — chayyayv, veaf al pi shemmechallel et hashshabbat, yatza yede keria! la kashya: ha bemet dideh, ha bemet dealma.

Veha "meto" katane! leolam bemet dideh, uvehanach delav bene avelut ninhu. vei chacham hu — chayyove michayyayv, detanya: chacham shemmet — hakkol kerovav. hakkol kerovav salka datach?! ella ema: hakkol kikrovav, hakkol korin alav, hakkol choltzin alav, hakkol mavrin alav barchava. la tzericha, delav chacham hu.

Vei adam kasher hu chayyove michayyayv, detanya: mippene ma metim banav uvenotav shel adam keshehen ketannim — kede sheyyivke veyitabbel al adam kasher. kede sheyyivke?! ervona shakli minneh?! ella: mippene shello bacha vehitabbel al adam kasher, shekkol habboche al adam kasher mochalin lo al kol avonotav bishvil kavod sheasa. la tzericha, delav adam kasher hu.

Vei dekae bishat yetziat neshama — chayyove michayyayv, detanya: rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: haomed al hammet bishat yetziat neshama — chayyayv likroa, ha lema ze dome — lesefer tora shennisraf! la tzericha, dela kae bishat yetziat neshama.

Tinach meto, ella chamato achamato kashya! chamato achamato name la kashya, ha — rabbi yehuda, ha — rabbi shimon. ha rabbi yehuda, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — chayyayv aleha. ha rabbi shimon, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — patur aleha.

Emar deshamat leh lerabbi yehuda bimtakken, bimkalkel mi shamat leh? amar rabbi avin: hay name metakkan hu, dekaaved nachat ruach leyitzro. uchehay gavvna mi shere? vehatanya, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer mishshum chilfa bar agra sheamar mishshum rabbi yochanan ben nuri: hamekare begadav bachamato, vehameshabber kelav bachamato, vehamefazzer meotav bachamato, yehe beenecha keoved avoda zara. shekkach ummanuto shel yetzer hara: hayyom omer lo ase kach, ulemachar omer lo ase kach, ad sheomer lo avod avoda zara veholech veoved. amar rabbi avin: may keraa — "lo yihye vecha el zar velo tishtachave leel nechar", ezehu el zar sheyyesh begufo shel adam? heve omer, ze yetzer hara.
La tzericha, deka aved lemirma emta ainashe beteh. ki ha derav yehuda shalef metzavyayta, rav acha bar yaakov tavar mane tevire, rav sheshet rame la leamteh monine aresha, rabbi abba tavar nichtema.

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi, amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, mishshum bar kappara: kol hammorid demaot al adam kasher, hakkadosh baruch hu sofran umannichan bevet genazav, shenneemar: "nodi safarta atta sima dimati venodecha halo besifratecha". amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hammitatztzel behespedo shel chacham — rauy lekovro bechayyav, shenneemar: "vayyikberu oto bigvul nachalato betimnat serach asher behar efrayim mitztzefon lehar gaash", melammed sheragash alehen har lehorgan. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammitatztzel behespedo shel chacham, eno maarich yamim — midda keneged midda, shenneemar: "besassea beshallechah terivenna".

Etiveh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: "vayyaavdu haam et Adonai kol yeme yehoshua vechol yeme hazzekenim asher heerichu yamim achare yehoshua"! amar leh, bavlay: yamim heerichu, shanim lo heerichu. ella meatta: "lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem" — yamim velo shanim? beracha shane.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: echad min haachin shemmet —

a: Yidagu kol haachin kullan. echad mibbene chavura shemmet — tidag kol hachavura kullah. amri la demet gadol, veamri la demet katan.

Vechol hamekalkelin peturin. tane rabbi avahu kammeh derabbi yochanan: kol hamekalkelin peturin chutz mechovel umavir. amar leh: pok tane levara, chovel umavir enah mishna. veim timtza lomar mishna — chovel betzarich lechalbo, mavir betzarich leefro.
Vehaanan tenan: kol hamekalkelin peturin! matnitin rabbi yehuda, barayyta rabbi shimon. may tama derabbi shimon: middeitzterich kera lemishre mila, ha chovel bealma chayyayv.
Umiddaasar rachamana haveara gabbe bat kohen, shema minna mavir bealma chayyayv.
Verabbi yehuda? hatam — metakken hu, kidrav ashe. deamar rav ashe: ma li letakken milla, ma li letakken keli. ma li levashshel petila, ma li levashshel sammanin.
Shiur hamelabben kulei. rav yosef machve kaful, rav chiyyay bar amme machve pashut.
Mishna rabbi yehuda omer: hatztzad tzippor lammigdal, utzevi labbayit — chayyayv. vachachamim omrim: tzippor lammigdal
b: Utzevi lagginna velechatzer velabbevarin — [chayyayv]. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: lo kol habbevarin shavin. ze hakkelal: mechussar tzida — patur, sheeno mechussar tzida — chayyayv.

Gemara tenan hatam: en tzadin dagim min habbevarin beyom tov, veen notnin lifnehem mezonot. aval tzadin chayya vaof, venotnin lifnehem mezonot. ureminhu: bevarin shel chayyot veshel ofot veshel dagim — en tzadin mehem beyom tov, veen notnin lifnehem mezonot. kashya chayya achayya, kashya ofot aofot.
Bishlama chayya achayya la kashya: ha rabbi yehuda, ha rabbanan.

Ella ofot aofot kashya! vechi tema, ofot aofot name la kashya: ha bevar mekore, ha bevar sheeno mekore — veha bayit dimkore hu, uven lerabbi yehuda uven lerabbanan tzippor lammigdal — in, labbayit — la!

Amar rabba bar rav huna: hacha betzippor deror askinan, lefi sheenah mekabbelet marut. detana deve rabbi yishmael: lamma nikra shemah "tzippor deror" — mippene sheddara babbayit kevassade. hasheta deatet lehachi — chayya achayya name la kashya, ha bevevar gadol, ha bevevar katan.

Hechi dame bevar gadol, hechi dame bevar katan? amar rav ashe: kol hecha derahet batreh umate le bechad shichyay — bevar katan, veiddach — bevar gadol. i name: kol hecha denafel tulla dichtalim ahadade — bevar katan, veiddach — bevar gadol. vei name: kol hecha delekka uketze uketze — bevar katan, veiddach — bevar gadol.

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer vechulei. amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel. amar leh abbaye: halacha, mikkelal difligi? amar leh may nafka lach minna? amar leh gemara gemor zemorta tehe?

Tanu rabbanan: hatztzad tzevi some veyashen — chayyayv. chigger, vezaken vechole — patur. amar leh abbaye lerav yosef: may shena hane, umay shena hane? hane avidi lerabboye, hane la avidi lerabboye. vehatanya: chole chayyayv! amar rav sheshet, la kashya: ha bechole mechamat ishshata, ha bechole mechamat uvetzana.

Tanu rabbanan: hatztzad chagavin, gazzin, tzerain veyattushin beshabbat — chayyayv, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: kol shebbemino nitztzod — chayyayv, vechol sheen bemino nitztzod — patur. tanya iddach: hatztzad chagavim bishat hattal — patur, bishat hashsharav — chayyayv. elazar ben mahavay omer: im hayu mekallechot uvaot — patur. ibbaya lehu: elazar ben mahavay aresha kae, o assefa kae? ta shema: hatztzad chagavin bishat hattal — patur, bishat hashsharav — chayyayv, elazar ben mahavay omer: afillu bishat hashsharav, im hayu mekallechot uvaot — patur.
Mishna tzevi shennichnas labbayit venaal echad befanav — chayyayv. naalu shenayim — peturin. lo yachol echad linol venaalu shenayim — chayyayvin. verabbi shimon poter.
Gemara amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar shemuel: hatztzad ari beshabbat — eno chayyayv ad sheyyachnisennu laggurezaki shello.

Mishna yashav haechad al happetach velo milleahu, yashav hashsheni umilleahu — hashsheni chayyayv. yashav harishon al happetach umilleahu, uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo, af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo — harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur. ha lema ze dome — lenoel et beto leshomro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho.

a: Gemara amar rabbi abba amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: nichnesa lo tzippor tachat kenafav — yoshev umeshammerah ad shettechshach. metiv rav nachman bar yitzchak: yashav harishon al happetach umilleahu, uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo, af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo — harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur. may lav, patur aval asur? la, patur umuttar. hachi name mistabbera, middekatane sefa: lema ze dome — lenoel et beto leshomro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho, mikkelal defatur umuttar! shema minna.

Ikka deamri, amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: af anan name tenena: af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo — harishon chayyayv vehashsheni patur, may lav patur umuttar? la, patur aval asur. ha middekatane sefa: ha lema ze dome — lenoel et beto leshomro, venimtza tzevi shamur betocho, mikkelal defatur umuttar. shema minna.

Amar shemuel: kol peture deshabbat patur aval asur, levar mehane telat defatur umuttar: chada ha, umimmay defatur umuttar? — dekatane sefa lema ze dome — lenoel et beto leshomro, venimtza tzevi shamur betocho. veiddach: hammefis muresa beshabbat, im laasot lah pe — chayyayv, im lehotzi mimmenna lecha — patur. umimmay defatur umuttar? ditnan: machat shel yad — littol bah et hakkotz. veiddach: hatztzad nachash beshabbat, im mitassek bo shello yishshechennu — patur, im lirfua — chayyayv, umimmay defatur umuttar? — ditnan: kofin keara al hanner bishvil shello teechoz bakkora, veal tzoa shel katan, veal akrav shello tishshoch.
Haderan alach haoreg

Mishna shemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hatztzadan vehachovel bahen chayyayv, ushear shekatzim uremasim, hachovel bahen patur, hatztzadan letzorech — chayyayv, shello letzorech — patur. chayya vaof shebbirshuto, hatztzadan — patur, vehachovel bahen — chayyayv.

Gemara middekatane "hachovel bahen chayyayv" mikkelal deit lehu or. man tanna? amar shemuel: rabbi yochanan ben nuri hi, ditnan, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot. rabba bar rav huna amar rav: afillu tema rabbanan, ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi yochanan ben nuri ella leinyan tumea, dichtiv: "elle hattemeim lachem", lerabbot sheorotehen kivsaran, aval leinyan shabbat — afillu rabbanan modu.
Uleinyan shabbat la peligi?! vehatanya: hatztzad echad mishshemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hachovel bahen — chayyayv, divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri, vachachamim omrim: en or ella
b: Lema shemmanu chachamim. adderabba, lema shemmanu chachamim en lahem or! veamar abbaye, hachi kaamar: en or chaluk mibbasar ella lema shello manu chachamim, amar leh rava: ha "lema shemmanu chachamim" kaamar? ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: en or metamme kevasar ella lema shemmanu chachamim. mikkelal derabbi yochanan ben nuri hanach name delo manu chachamim metammein? veha katane, rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot velo metammein! [amar rav] adda bar matna: taretz hachi, vachachamim omrim: leinyan tumea en or lema shemmanu chachamim.

Veakkatti, leinyan shabbat la peligi? vehatanya: hatztzad echad mishshemona sheratzim haamurim battora, hachovel bahen — chayyayv, bishratzim sheyyesh lahen orot. veezo hi chabbura sheenah chozeret — nitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza. rabbi yochanan ben nuri omer: shemona sheratzim yesh lahen orot.

Amar rav ashe: man tanna kamma — rabbi yehuda deazel batar gishta. ditnan, rabbi yehuda omer: halletaa kechuleda. aval rabbanan difligi aleh derabbi yochanan leinyan tumea, leinyan shabbat modu leh. i hachi, hay "divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri", "divre rabbi yochanan umachluketo" mibbee leh! teni: "divre rabbi yochanan ben nuri umachluketo".

Bea minneh levi merabbi: minnayin lechabbura sheenah chozeret? dichtiv: "hayahafoch kushi oro venamer chavarburotav". may "chavarburotav"? illema dekae rikme rikme — hay "venamer chavarburotav", "namer gevonav" mibbee leh! ella — kechushi: ma oro dechushi enah chozeret, af chabbura enah chozeret.

Ushear shekatzim kulei. ha horgan — chayyayv. man tanna? amar rabbi yirmeya: rabbi eliezer hi. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: hahoreg kinna beshabbat — kehoreg gamal beshabbat. matkif la rav yosef: ad kan la peligi rabbanan aleh derabbi eliezer ella bechinna, deenah para verava. aval shear shekatzim uremasim defarin veravin — la peligi.

Ushenehem lo lemaduha ella meelim. rabbi eliezer savar keelim: ma elim sheyyesh bahen netilat neshama — af kol sheyyesh bo netilat neshama. verabbanan savri keelim: ma elim defarin veravin — af kol defare verave. amar leh abbaye: vechinna en para verava? vehaamar mar: yoshev hakkadosh baruch hu vezan mikkarne remim vead betze chinnim! mina hu demikkere "betze chinnim".

Vehatanya: tippuyin uvetze chinnim! mina hu demikkere "betze chinnim". vahare parosh defare verave, vetanya: hatztzad parosh beshabbat, rabbi eliezer mechayyev verabbi yehoshua poter! amar rav ashe: tzeda ahariga karamet?! ad kan la peligi rabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua, ella demar savar: davar sheen bemino nitztzod — chayyayv, umar savar: patur. aval leinyan hariga — afillu rabbi yehoshua mode.
Hatztzadan letzorech chayyayv vechulei. man tanna? amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi shimon hi, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — patur aleha.

Ikka dematne la aha: hammefis muresa beshabbat, im laasot lah pe — chayyayv, im lehotzi mimmenna lecha — patur. man tanna? amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi shimon hi, deamar melacha sheen tzericha legufah — patur aleha.

Veikka dematne la aha: hatztzad nachash beshabbat, im mitassek bo shello yishshechennu — patur, im lirfua — chayyayv. man tanna? amar rav yehuda amar rav: rabbi shimon hi, deamar melacha sheenah tzericha legufah patur aleha.
Amar shemuel: hashshole dag min hayyam, kevan sheyyavesh bo kesela — chayyayv. amar rabbi yose bar avin: uven senappirav. amar rav ashe: la tema yavesh mammash, ella afillu deaved rire.

Amar mar bar hamedure amar shemuel: hoshit yado lime behema vedildel ubbar shebbemeeha — chayyayv. may tama? amar rava: bar hamedure asbera li, lav amar rav sheshet: hay man ditlash keshuta mehizme vehige michayyayv mishshum oker davar miggiddulo. hacha name, michayyayv mishshum oker davar miggiddulo. amar abbaye: hay man ditlash

a: Pitra meunna dechatzba — michayyayv mishshum oker davar miggiddulo. metiv rav oshaya: hattolesh meatzitz nakuv — chayyayv, vesheeno nakuv — patur. hatam — lav hayeynu reviteh, hacha — hayeynu reviteh.

Chayya vaof kulei. amar rav huna: kotvin tefillin al gabbe or shel of tahor. amar rav yosef: may kamashma lan? deit leh or — tenena: hachovel bahen — chayyayv! amar leh abbaye: tuva kamashma lan, dei mimmatnitin, hava amena kevan deit beh nikve nikve la, kamashma lan kidamri bemareva: kol nekev shehaddeyo overet alav — eno nekev.
Metiv rabbi zera: "bichnafav", lehacheshir et haor. vei salka datach or hu, hechi merabbe leh kera? amar leh abbaye: or hu verachamana rabbeyeh.

Ikka deamri, amar rabbi zera: af anan name tenena, "bichnafav" — lerabbot et haor. i amrat bishlama or hu — hayeynu deitzterich kera lerabboyeh. ella i amrat lav or hu — ammay itzterich kera lerabboyeh? amar leh abbaye: leolam ema lach lav or hu, veitzterich: salka datach amena kevan deit beh pirtze pirtze meis — kamashma lan.

Bea minneh mar bereh deravina merav nachman bar yitzchak: mahu lichtov tefillin al gabbe or shel dag tahor? amar leh: im yavo eliyyahu veyomar. may "im yavo eliyyahu veyomar"? illema i deit leh or, i delet leh or — ha chazenan deit leh or! veod, hatnan: atzmot haddag veoro matztzilin beohel hammet! ella im yavo eliyyahu veyomar i pesaka zuhama minneh, i la pesaka zuhama minneh.

Shemuel vekarna havo yatvi aggudda dinhar malka. chazonhu lemayya deka delu vaachiri. amar leh shemuel lekarna: gavra rabba kaate mimmareva vechayesh bimeh, veka delu mayya leakbole appeh (kammeh), zil tehi leh akkankanneh. azal ashkecheh lerav. amar leh: minnayin sheen kotvin tefillin ella al gabbe or behema tehora? amar leh: dichtiv: "lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha" — min hammuttar befich. minnayin laddam shehu adom? shenneemar: "vayyiru moav minneged et hammayim adummim kaddam".

Minnayin lammila shebbeoto makom? neemar kan "orlato", veneemar lehallan "orlato", ma lehallan davar sheose peri — af kan davar sheose peri. ema libbo, dichtiv: "umaltem et orlat levavchem"?! ema ozno, dichtiv: "hinne arela oznam"?! danin "orlato" tamma meorlato" tamma, veen danin "orlato" tamma meorlato" sheenah tamma.
Amar leh: may shemach? karna. amar leh: yehe raava detippok leh karna beeneh.

Lesof ayyeyleh shemuel leveteh, ochleh nahama disare vechasa deharsana veashkeyeh shichra vela achvi leh bet hakkisse ki hechi delishtalshal. lat rav vaamar: man dimtzaaran — la likayyeymu leh bene, vechen hava.

Ketannae: minnayin lammila shebbeoto makom? neemar kan "orlato", veneemar lehallan "orlato". ma lehallan davar sheose peri, af kan davar sheose peri — divre rabbi yoshiyya. rabbi natan omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar orlato" — mekom shennikkar ben zachrut lenakvut.

Tanu rabbanan: kotvin tefillin al gabbe or behema tehora, veal gabbe or chayya tehora, veal gabbe or nevelot uterefot shellahen. venichrachot besaaran venitparot begidan, vahalacha lemoshe missinay shehattefillin nichrachot besaaran venitparot begidan. aval en kotvin lo al gabbe or behema temea, velo al gabbe or chayya temea, veeno tzarich lomar al gabbe or nevela uterefa shellahen. veen nichrachot besaaran, veen nitparot begidan.

Vezo sheela shaal baytosi echad et rabbi yehoshua haggarsi: minnayin sheen kotvin tefillin al or behema temea? dichtiv: "lemaan tihye torat Adonai beficha" — middavar hammuttar befich. ella meatta, al gabbe or nevelot uterefot al yikkatvu! amar lo: emshol lecha mashal, ha lema haddavar dome — lishne bene adam shennitchayyeyvu hariga lammalchut. echad harago melech veechad harago ispaklator, eze mehen meshubbach — heve omer ze sheharago melech. ella meatta yeachlu! amar leh: hattora amra "lo tochlu chol nevela", veat amrat yeachlu?! amar leh: kalos.
Mishna en osin helme beshabbat,
b: Aval ose hu et me hammelach, vetovel bahen pitto, venoten letoch hattavshil. amar rabbi yose: vahalo hu helme, ben merubbe uven muat! veellu hen me melach hammuttarin — noten shemen lechattechilla letoch hammayim o letoch hammelach.
Gemara may kaamar? amar rav yehuda amar shemuel, hachi kaamar: en osin me melach merubbin, aval ose hu me melach muatin.

Amar rabbi yose: vahalo hu helme, ben merubbin ben muatin. ibbaya lehu: rabbi yose leesor o lehattir? amar rav yehuda: lehattir. middela katane "rabbi yose oser". amar leh rabba: ha middekatane sefa veellu hen me melach hammuttarin, mikkelal derabbi yose leesor. ella amar rabba: leesor. vechen amar rabbi yochanan: leesor.

Tanya name hachi: en osin me melach merubbin latet letoch hakkevashin shebbetoch gistera. aval ose hu me melach muatin, veochel bahen pitto, venoten letoch hattavshil. amar rabbi yose: vechi mippene shehallalu merubbin vehallalu muatin hallalu asurin vehallalu muttarin? yomru: melacha merubba — asura, melacha muetet — mutteret! ella ellu vaellu asurin hen. veellu hen me melach hammuttarin — noten shemen umelach o shemen umayim, uvilvad shello yitten mayim umelach lechattechilla.
Azzin tzenon veetrog siman.

Tane rabbi yehuda bar chaviva: en osin me melach azzin. may me melach azzin? rabba verav yosef bar abba deamri tarvavyyhu: kol shehabbetza tzafa bahen. vechamma? amar abbaye: tere tilte milcha vetilta mayya.

Lemay avdi la? amar rabbi avahu: lemureyysa. tane rabbi yehuda bar chaviva: en molchin tzenon uvetza beshabbat. rav chizkiyya mishshemeh deabbaye amar: tzenon — asur, uvetza — mutteret. amar rav nachman: meresh hava malachna pugela, amena: afsode ka mafsedna leh, daamar shemuel: pugela churepeh mealle. kevan dishmana leha, dechi ata ulla veamar bemareva malchi kishre kishre, mimlach la malachna, tabbole vadday metabbelna.
Tane rabbi yehuda bar chaviva: etrog tzenon uvetza, ilmale kelippatan hachitzona enan yotzin mibbene meayim leolam.

Ki ata rav dimi amar: meolam la teva gavra beyamma disdom. amar rav yosef: haficha sedom, vahafichan millaha. gavra hu dela tava, keshura tava?! amar leh abbaye, la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya keshura daafillu bechol memot shebbaolam la tava, ella afillu gavra detava bechol memot shebbaolam, beyamma disdom la tava. lemay nafka minna? ki ha deravin hava shakel veazel achoreh derabbi yirmeya aggudda deyamma disdom. amar leh: mahu lemimshe mehane mayya beshabbeta. amar leh: shappir dame.

Mahu lemimmatz ulemiftach? amar leh: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati. deamar rabbi zera, zimnin amar la mishshemeh derav matna vezimnin amar la mishshemeh demar ukeva, vetarvavyyhu mishshemeh daavu dishmuel velevi amrin, chad amar: yayin, betoch haayin — asur, al gav haayin — muttar. vechad amar: rok tafel [afillu] al gav haayin — asur.

Tistayyem daavu dishmuel hu deamar yayin betoch haayin — asur, al gav haayin — muttar, middeamar shemuel: shore adam pitto beyayin venotno al gav haayin beshabbat. dishmia leh mimman — lav dishmia leh meavu? velitamaych, ha deamar shemuel: rok tafel afillu al gabbe haayin asur, dishmia leh mimman? illema dishmia leh meavu, ella levi — vela chada amar?! ella: chada shemia leh meavu vachada shemia leh millevi, vela yadinan he meavu he millevi.

Amar mar ukeva amar shemuel: shore adam kilorin meerev shabbat venoten al gav enav beshabbat, veeno choshesh. bar levay hava kae kammeh demar ukeva. chazyeh dahava ametz ufatach. amar leh: kulle hay vadday la shera mar shemuel. shelach leh rabbi yannay lemar ukeva: lishaddar lan mar mehanach kilorin demar shemuel. shelach leh: shaddore meshaddarna lach, dela tema tzar ayin ana, ella hachi amar shemuel: tova tippat tzonen shacharit urechitzat yadayim veraglayim bechammin arvit mikkol kilorin shebbaolam. tanya name hachi, amar rabbi muna mishshum rabbi yehuda: tova tippat tzonen shacharit urechitzat yadayim veraglayim arvit mikkol kilorin shebbaolam.

Hu haya omer: yad laayin — tikkatzetz. yad lachotem — tikkatzetz. yad lappe — tikkatzetz. yad laozen — tikkatzetz. yad lachasuda — tikkatzetz. yad laamma — tikkatzetz. yad lefi tabbaat — tikkatzetz. yad

a: Laggigit — tikkatzetz, yad mesamma, yad machreshet, yad maala polippus. tanya, rabbi natan omer: bat chorin hi zo umakpedet ad sheyyirchotz yadav shalosh peamim. amar rabbi yochanan: puch maavir bat melech, ufosek et haddima, umarbe sear baafappayim. tanya name hachi, rabbi yose omer: puch maavir bat melech, ufosek et haddima, umarbe sear baafappayim.

Veamar mar ukeva amar shemuel: alin en bahem mishshum refua. amar rav yosef: kusebarta en bah mishshum refua. amar rav sheshet: keshut en bahen mishshum refua. amar rav yosef: kusebarta, afillu ledidi kashya li. amar rav sheshet: gargira, afillu ledidi mealle [li]. veamar mar ukeva amar shemuel: kol mine keshut sheru levar mittaroza.

Amar rav chisda: shirka tavya — shere, pipue vee — asur. devethu dizeri avada leh lechiyyay bar ashe, vela achal. amara leh: lerabbach avadi leh vaachal, veat la achlat?! zeeri letameh, deamar zeeri: noten adam yayin tzalul umayim tzelulin letoch hameshammeret beshabbat veeno choshesh. alma kevan demishtete hachi — lav midde kaaved, hacha name kevan demittechil hachi — lav midde kaaved.

Veamar mar ukeva: mi shenniggefa yado o raglo, tzomtah beyayin veeno choshesh. ibbaya lehu: challa may? amar rav hillel lerav ashe: ki havena be rav kahana amri challa la. amar rava: vehane bene machoza, kevan dimfanneki — afillu chamra name masse lehu.

Ravina ikkela leve rav ashe, chazyeh didricha leh chamara aggabba dechareh, veyatev ka tzamet leh bechalla. amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rav hillel challa la? amar leh: gav hayyad vegav haregel shane.

Ikka deamri, chazyeh deka tzamet leh bechamra. amar leh: la savar la mar leha deamar rava: hane bene machoza kevan dimfanneki — afillu chamra name masse lehu? umar name ha mefannak! amar leh: gav hayyad vegav haregel shane. deamar rav adda bar matna amar rav: gav hayyad vegav haregel hare hen kemakka shel chalal umechallelin alehen et hashshabbat.
Tanu rabbanan: rochatzim beme gerar, beme chammatan, beme asya uveme teverya, aval lo bayyam haggadol velo beme mishra velo beyammah shel sedom.
Ureminhu: rochatzim beme teverya uvayyam haggadol, aval lo beme mishra velo beyammah shel sedom — kashya yam haggadol ayyam haggadol!

Amar rabbi yochanan, la kashya: ha — rabbi meir, ha — rabbi yehuda. ditnan: kol hayyammim kemikve, shenneemar: "ulemikve hammayim kara yammim", divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: yam haggadol kemikve, velo neemar "yammim", ella sheyyesh bo mine yammim harebe.
Rabbi yose omer: kol hayyammim metaharin bezochalin, ufesulim lezavim velimtzoraim ulekaddesh bahen me chattat. matkef la rav nachman bar yitzchak:
b: Emor difligi leinyan tumea vetohora, leinyan shabbat mi shamat lehu? ella amar rav nachman bar yitzchak, la kashya: ha deishtahi, ha dela ishtahi.

Bemay okemta levatrayyta — dela ishtahi, i dela ishtahi — afillu beme mishra name. dehatanya: rochatzin beme teverya uveme mishra uveyamma shel sedom, veaf al pi sheyyesh lo chatatim berosho. bamme devarim amurim — shello nishtaha, aval nishtaha — asur.
Ella yam haggadol ayyam haggadol la kashya: ha — beyafin shebbo, ha — beraim shebbo. me mishra amme mishra name la kashya: ha — deishtahi, ha — dela ishtahi.

Mishna en ochlin ezovyon beshabbat lefi sheeno maachal beriim, aval ochel hu et yoezer, veshote abbuveroe. kol haochalin — ochel adam lirfua, vechol hammashkin — shote, chutz mimme dekalim vechos ikkarin, mippene shehen liroka. aval shote hu me dekalim litzmao, vesach shemen ikkarin shello lirfua.

Gemara amar rav yosef: ezov — "avrata bar hamag", ezovyon — "avrata bar hing". ulla amar: marva chivvara. ulla ikkela leve rav shemuel bar yehuda, ayyto lekammeh marva chivvara. amar: hayeynu ezov dichtiv beorayyta. rav pappe amar: shumeshuk. amar rav yirmeya middifti: kevoteh derav pappe mistabbera, ditnan: mitzvat ezov shelosha kelachin uvahen shelosha givolin, veshumeshuk hu demishtachcha hachi. lemay achli leh — lekukeyane. bemay achli leh — bishva tamre ukkamata. mimmay havya — mikkimcha disare bemana dachalef aleh arbein yomin.

Aval ochel hu et yoezer. may yoezer? puttank. lemay achli la — learkata. bemay achli la — bishva tamre chiuorata. mimmay havya — meumetza umayya allibba rekana, umibbisra shammina allibba rekana, umibbisra detora allibba rekana, meamguza allibba rekana, umiggire deruveya allibba rekana umishte mayya abbatreh.

Vei la — livla tachle chiuorata. vei la — littiv betaanita, velayte bisra shammina velishde aggumere, velimetz garma, veligamma challa. veikka deamri: challa la, mishshum dekashe lechavda. vei la — layyte girda daasinta digrida meillay letattay, vela mittattay leillay, dilma nafka ayyeyde pummeh, velishleka beshichra be shivave, ulemachar niskerinnun lenikvin dideh velishte, vechi mippene — mippene appeshicha dedikla.

Veshotin abbuveroe. may abbuveroe? chumatriyya. may chumatriyya? chutera yechidaa. lemay avdi la — legilluya. vei la — layte chamsha kelile vechamsha kosata deshichra, venishlokinhu bahade hadade ad dekayyma aanpaka, venishte.

Immeh derav achadvuy bar amme avada leh lehahu gavra chad kelila vechad kosta deshichra. shelaka veayshkiteh, ushegara tannura ugerafteh, (vaavatebaytayh labeynetaa) [veotiva beh leventa, veotivteh] begavvevy, unefak [minneh] kehutza yarka.

Rav avya amar: revieta dachalava meizza chivvarta. rav huna bar yehuda amar: layyte etroga chalita velichayyeykeh velimalleyeh duvesha, velotve be mille denura, velechleh. rabbi chanina amar, me raglayim bene arbaim yom: barzina — lezibbura, revieta — leakrabba, palga riva — legilluya, riva — afillu lichshafim meallu. amar rabbi yochanan: anigron, vaavangar, vetiryayka — meallu ben legilluya ben lichshafim.

Hay man divla chivya — lochleh keshuta bemilcha, velayrhateh telata mille. rav shimi bar ashe chazyeh lehahu gavra divla chivya. iddemi leh kefarasha. ochleh keshuta bemilcha vearhateh kammeh telata mille, unefak minneh gubbe gubbe. ikka deamri: rav shimi bar ashe bela chivya, ata eliyyahu iddemi leh kefarasha. ochleh keshuta bemilcha vearhateh kammeh telata mille unefak minneh gubbe gubbe. hay man detarkeh chivya — lete ubbara dachamara chivvarti, velikreeh, velotveh illaveh. vehane mille dela ishtechach terefa. hahu

a: Bar kashsha defumebdita detarkeh chivya, hava telesre chamare chivvarata befumebdita, karinhu lechullehu, veishtechachu terefa. havay chada behahu gisa defumebdita, ad deazli mayyti la achla arya. amar lehu abbaye: dilma chivya derabbanan tarkeh, delet leh asvata, dichtiv: "uforetz gader yishshechennu nachash". amaru leh: in rabbi, dechi nach nafsheh derav, gezar rav yitzchak bar bisna delekka delaymte assa vegidme leve hillula [betavla], vaazal ihu amti assa vegidme leve hillula betavla. tarkeh chivya, umit.

Hay man decharcheh chivya — linchot lemayya velischof dikkula aresheh ulehaddekeh minneh, vechi salek illaveh — lishdeye lemayya velislok velete. hay man demikkanne beh chivya, i ikka chavreh bahadeh — layrkeveh arba garmide, vei la — lishvar nigra, vei la — libar nahara, uvelelya — lotveh lefurye — aarba chavyata, venigne be chochve, velayyte arbea shunnare velesrinhu bearbea kare defureyeh, velayte shachafe velishde hatam, dechi shami kaleh achli leh. hay man derahet abbatreh — lirhot be chalata.
Hay itteta dechazya chivya, vela yada i yahev dateh illava i la yahev dateh illava — tishlach mana vetishde kammeh, i michrach behu dateh illava, vei la — la yahev dateh illava.

May takkante teshammesh kammeh. ikka deamri: kol shekken detakef leh yitzreh! ella tishkol mimmazzeya umittufera vetishde beh, vetema: "dishtana ana". hay itteta deayel ba chivya, lifasseuha velotvuha attarte chavyata, velayte bisra shammina velishde aggumere, velayte aggana detachle vechamra rechtana velotvu hatam, velitrokinhu bahade hadade, velinkot tzevata bide, dechi morach recha — nafek veate, velishkeleh velikleyeh benura, dei la — hadar illava.

Kol haochalin kulei. kol haochalin leetoye may? leetoye techol lashshinnayim vecharshinin livne meayim. kol hammashkin leetoye may? leetoye me tzelafin bechometz. amar leh ravina lerava: mahu lishtot me raglayim beshabbat? amar leh, tenena: "kol hammashkin shote", ume raglayim la shatu inashe.

Chutz mimme dekalim. tana: chutz mimme dekarim. man ditna "me dekarim" — shehem dokrim et hammara, uman deamar "me dekalim" — sheyyotzin min shene dikle. may me dekalim? amar rabba bar berona: tarte taley ikka bemareva, venafka ena demayya mibbenayyhu. kasa kamma — merappe, iddach — meshalshel, veiddach — ki hechi deayyli hachi nafki. amar ulla: ledidi shete [li] shichra devavlae, umealle minnayyhu. vehu dela regil beh arbein yomin.

Rav yosef amar: zetom hammitzri tilta seare, vetilta kuretme, vetilta milcha. rav pappa amar: tilleta chitte, vetilta kuretme, vetilta milcha vechammona, vesimanaych — sisane. veshate lehu ben divcha laatzarta, dikmit — merappe leh, vedirfe — kamet leh.

Vechos ikkarin. may kos ikkarin? amar rabbi yochanan: layyte matkal zuza kuma alekkesanderaya, umatkal zuza gavya gila, umatkal zuza kurekma rishka, velishchakinhu bahade hadade. lezava — telata bechamra, vela miakra. leyarkona — teren beshichra, umiakar. lezava telata bechamra, vela miakra. vei la — layyte telata
b: Kefize shamche farsae, venishlok bechamra, venashkeyay, venema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — lotva apparashat derachim, velanketa kasa dechamra bida, velayte inish meachora velivaata, velema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layte buna dechammona uvuna demorika uvuna deshabbelilta, venishlok bechamra, venashkeyay, venema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layte shittin shie dedanna, velashpeya, velema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layte peshitna, velishlok bechamra, velishpeya, venema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layte charnuga dehigta romita, velikle, velisseva beshachake dechittana bekayyta uveshachake daamar gufena besitva.

Vei la — lichre sheva bere, velikle behu shevishata (yalda) deorla, velaynketa kasa dechamra bida, velokma meha velotva aha, velokma meha velotva aha, veakkol chada vachada lema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layyte semida, velescha mippalga letattay, velema la: kum mizzovich. vei la — layte beata denaamita, velikle, velisseva beshachake dechittana bekayyta uveshachake daamar gufena besitva. vei la — liftach la chavita dechamra lishma. vei la — linkit searta demishtachcha bichfuta dechudanya chivvarta, i nakta chad yoma — paska tere yome, vei nakta tere yome — paska telata yome, vei nakta telata yome — paska leolam.

Leyarkona teren beshichra, umiakar. vei la — layyte resha deshibbuta demilcha velishlok beshichra, velishte. vei la — layyte monine dekamtze. vei lekka monine dekamtze — layyte monine dinkire, veliayyleh leve vane velishpeyeh. vei lekka be vane — lokmeh ben tannura legudda. amar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyechammemennu — yekannechennu bisdino. rav acha bar yosef chash beh, avad leh rav kahana, veittassi.

Vei la — layte telata kefizi tamre parseyayta, utelata kefize dekira denishterufe, utelata kefize ahala tolana, velishlokinhu beshichra, velishte. vei la — layte ila bar chamara, veligallach metziata deresha, velishbok leh dema meapputeh, velotveh aresheh, velizdehar meeneh dela lissamme lehu. vei la — layte resha devarcha demannach bechivsha, velishlok beshichra, velishte. vei la — layte davar acher chuterana, velikreeh, velotveh allibbeh. vei la — layte karate mikkavtevata demeshare.

Hahu tayyaya dechash beh, amar leh leginnay: shekol gelimay vehav li meshara decharate. yehav leh veachla. amar leh: oshlan gelimaych veegne beh kalli. ikkerach gena beh. kad ichammam vekam, nefal pureta pureta minneh.

Leyarkona teren beshichra, umiakar. umi shere? vehatanya, minnayin lasserus baadam shehu asur — talmud lomar: "uveartzechem lo taasu" — bachem lo taasu, divre rabbi chanina. hane mille — hecha deka mikkavven, hacha — meatzmo hu. deamar rabbi yochanan: harotze sheyyesares tarnegol — yittol karbolto, umistares meelav. vehaamar rav ashe: ramut rucha hu dinkita leh. ella besaris.
Vehaamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Hakkol modim bimchammetz achar mechammetz shehu chayyayv, shenneemar: "lo teafe chametz", "lo tease chametz". bimsares acher mesares shehu chayyayv, shenneemar: "umauch vechatut venatuk vecharut", im al karut chayyayv, al natuk lo kol shekken! ella, lehavi notek achar koret shehu chayyayv. veella bezaken.

Vehaamar rabbi yochanan hen hen hechziruni lenaaruti! ella beishsha. ulerabbi yochanan ben beroka deamar al shenehem hu omer: "vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem peru urevu" — may ikka lememar? bizkenah, i name baakara.

Mishna hachoshesh beshinnav — lo yegammea bahen et hachometz, aval metabbel hu kedarko, veim nitrappe — nitrappe. hachoshesh bemotnav — la yasuch yayin vachometz, aval sach hu et hashshemen. velo shemen vevred. bene melachim sachin shemen vered al makkotehen, shekken darkan lasuch bechol. rabbi shimon omer: kol yisrael bene melachim hem.

Gemara rame leh rav acha aricha dehu rav acha bar pappa lerabbi avahu: tenan, hachoshesh beshinnav — lo yegammea bahen et hachometz. lememra dechometz mealle leshinnayim?! vehachtiv: "kachometz lashshinnayim vecheashan laenayim"! la kashya: ha bekiyyuha defere, ha bechalla. veibbaet ema, ha veha bechalla: ha deikka makka, ha delekka makka. ikka makka — masse, lekka makka — merappe.

Lo yegammea bahen et hachometz. vehatanya: lo yegammea ufolet, aval megammea uvolea! amar abbaye: ki tenan name matnitin, megammea ufolet tenan. rava amar: afillu tema megammea uvolea, kan — lifne tibbul, kan — leachar tibbul.
Venema: middelifne tibbul shere — leachar tibbul name shere. deshaminan leh lerava deit leh "hoil".
Deamar rava: lekka midde divshabbat shere uveyom hakkippurim asur, hoil divshabbat shere — beyom hakkippurim name shere!
Hadar beh rava mehach. mimmay demehach hadar beh, dilma mehahi hadar beh? la salka datach, detanya: kol chayyayve tevilot tovlin kedarkan, ben betisha beav ben beyom hakkippurim.

Hachoshesh bemotnav kulei. amar rabbi abba bar zavda amar rav: halacha kerabbi shimon. lememra derav kerabbi shimon sevira leh? vehaamar rav shimi bar chiyyay mishshemeh derav: hay mesocharyay denazyayta
b: Asir lehaddokeh beyoma tava! behahi afillu rabbi shimon mode. deabbaye verava deamri tarvavyyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut".

Vehaamar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda, verav chanan bar amme amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi shimon. verav chiyyay bar avin matne la bela gavre, rav amar: halacha kerabbi yehuda, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi shimon! ella amar rava: ani vaari shebbachavura targemna, umannu — rabbi chiyyay bar avin: halacha kerabbi shimon, velav mittameh.

May "halacha kerabbi shimon velav mittameh"? illema halacha kerabbi shimon — deshare, velav mittameh — deillu rabbi shimon savar masse, verav savar la masse. vesavar rav la masse? veha middekatane "bene melachim sachin al gabbe makkotehen shemen vevred", mikkelal demasse. ella: halacha kerabbi shimon — deshare, velav mittameh — deillu rabbi shimon savar: af al gav dela shechiach, shere. verav savar: i shechiach — in, vei la shechiach — la. uveatra derav shechiach mishcha devavrda.

Haderan alach shemone

sheratzim

Mishna veellu kesharim shechayyayvin alehen: kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin, ucheshem shehu chayyayv al kishshuran, kach hu chayyayv al hetteran. rabbi meir omer: kol kesher shehu yachol lehattiro beachat miyyadav — en chayyayvin alav.
Gemara may kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin? illema kitra dekatri bizmama, vekitra dekatri beistarida — hay kesher sheeno shel kayyayma hu! ella kitra dizmama gufeh, udeistarida gufa.

Rabbi meir omer kol kesher kulei. bae rav achadvuy achuy demar acha: aniva lerabbi meir mahu? tameh derabbi meir mishshum deyachol lehattiro beachat miyyadav hu — veha name yachol lehattiro, o dilma tama derabbi meir mishshum dela mihaddak — vehay [ha] mihaddak. teku.

Mishna yesh lecha kesharin sheen chayyayvin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchekesher hassappanin: kosheret ishsha miftach chalukah, vechute sevacha, veshel pasikya, uretzuot minal vesandal, venodot yayin vashemen, ukedera shel basar. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: koshrin lifne habbehema bishvil shello tetze.

Gemara ha gufa kashya: amrat yesh kesharin sheen chayyayvin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchekesher hassappanin: chiyyuva hu delekka, ha issura — ikka, vahadar tane: kosheret ishsha miftach chaluka: afillu lechattechilla! hachi kaamar: yesh kesharin sheen chayyayvin alehen kekesher haggammalin uchekesher hassappanin. umay nihu —

a: Kitra dekatri bizmama vekitra dekatri beistarida, chiyyuva hu delekka, ha issura — ikka. veyesh shemmuttarin lechattechilla, umay nihu — kosheret mifteche chalukah.
Miftach chalukah. peshita! la tzericha, deit leh tere dashshe. mahu detema: chada minnayyhu battole mevattel [la], ka mashma lan.
Vechute sevacha. peshita! la tzericha, dirvicha la. mahu detema: mishlaf shalfa la, ka mashma lan deishsha chasa al searah umishra sharya la.

Uretzuot minal vesandal. ittemar: hittir retzuot minal vesandal, tane chada: chayyayv chattat, vetanya iddach: patur aval asur, vetanya iddach: muttar lechattechilla. kashya minal amminal, kashya sandal assandal.
Minal amminal la kashya: ha dekatane chayyayv chattat — bidushekafe. patur aval asur — bedarbanan. muttar lechattechilla — bedivne machoza.

Sandal assandal la kashya: ha dekatane chayyayv chattat — bidtayyaye dekatri ushekafe. patur aval asur — bidchumarta dekatri inhu. muttar lechattechilla — besandal denafki beh be tere, kidrav yehuda. derav yehuda achu derav salla chasida hava leh hahu zuga desandale, zimnin denafek beh ihu, zimnin nafek beh yanokeh. ata lekammeh deabbaye, amar leh: kehay gavna may? amar leh: chayyayv chattat.

Amar leh: hasheta patur aval asur ka kashya li, "chayyayv chattat" kaamrat li?! may tama? amar leh: mishshum divchol name zimnin nafekna beh ana, zimnin nafek beh yanoka. amar leh: i hachi, muttar lechattechilla.

Rabbi yirmeya hava kaazel batreh derabbi avahu becharmelit. ippesik retzua desandaleh. amar leh: may eeved leh? amar leh: shekol gemi lach dachaze lemaachal behema, ucheroch illaveh. abbaye hava kae kammeh derav yosef. ippesik leh retzua. amar leh: may eeved leh? amar leh: shivkeh. may shena midderabbi yirmeya? hatam la minnetar, hacha minnetar. veha mana hu, dei baena hafechna leh miyyamin lismol? amar leh: middekamtaretz rabbi yochanan allibba derabbi yehuda, shema minna halacha kerabbi yehuda.

May hi? detanya: sandal shennifseku shete oznav, o shete teresiyyotav, o shennittal kol hakkaf shello — tahor. achat meoznav, o achat mitteresiyyotav, o shennittal rov hakkaf shello — tame. rabbi yehuda omer: nifseka penimit — tame. hachitzona — tahor. veamar ulla, veittema rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: kemachaloket leinyan tumea kach machaloket leinyan shabbat, aval lo leinyan chalitza.

Vehavenan ba: [rabbi yochanan] allibba deman? ilema allibba derabbanan: middilinyan tumea mana have — leinyan shabbat name mana have, aval lo lachalitza — delav mana hu, vehatnan: chaltza shel semol bayyamin chalitzatah keshera. veella allibba derabbi yehuda: middilinyan tumea lav mana hu — leinyan shabbat name lav mana hu, aval lo lachalitza demana hu.

Emar deamrinan chaltza shel semol bayyamin chalitzatah keshera — hicha dilmilleteh mana hu, hacha lemilleteh lav mana hu, deha amar rabbi yehuda: nifseka hachitzona tahor — alma lav mana hu! leolam allibba derabbi yehuda. ema: vechen lachalitza. veha kamashma lan: dechi amrinan chaltza shel semol beshel yamin chalitzatah keshera — hecha
b: Dilmilleteh mana hu, aval hacha — lemilleteh lav mana hu.

Umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: sandal shennifseka achat meoznav vetikkenah — tame midras, nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah — tahor milletamme midras, aval tame magga midras. may lav la shena penimit vela shena chitzona!

La, penimit davka. aval chitzona may — tahor? i hachi, addetane: nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah — tahor min hammidras aval tame magga midras, niflog bedida: bamme devarim amurim — shennifseka penimit, aval chitzona — tahor! amar rav yitzchak ben yosef: tehe mishnatenu besandal sheyyesh lo arba oznayim vearba teresiyyotayim, shello lishbor devarav shel rabbi yochanan.

Ki ata ravin amar rav chanan bar abba amar rav: halacha kerabbi yehuda. verabbi yochanan amar: en halacha kerabbi yehuda. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? veha middimtaretz rabbi yochanan allibba derabbi yehuda, shema minna kerabbi yehuda sevira leh! amorae ninhu veallibba derabbi yochanan.
Tenan hatam: kol kele baale vattim, shiuran kerimmonim. bae rabbi chizkiyya: nikkav kemotzi zayit usetamo, vechazar venikkav kemotzi zayit usetamo, ad shehishlimo lemotzi rimmon, mahu?

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: rabbi, shanita lanu sandal shennifseka achat meoznav vetikkenah — tame midras. nifseka sheniyya vetikkenah — tahor min hammidras, aval tame magga midras. veamrinan lach: may shena rishona — deha kayyma sheniyya? sheniyya name, [ha] mittakkena rishona!
Vaamart lan aleh: panim chadashot bau lechan. hacha name panim chadashot bau lechan.

Kare aleh: let den bar inash. ikka deamri: kegon den bar inash. amar rabbi zera amar rava bar zimmuna: im rishonim bene malachim — anu bene anashim. veim rishonim bene anashim — anu kachamorim. velo kachamoro shel rabbi chanina ben dosa veshel rabbi pinchas ben yair, ella kishar chamorim.
Venodot yayin vashemen. peshita! la tzericha, deit leh tarte unne, mahu detema: chada minnayyhu battole mevattel la, ka mashma lan.
Kedera shel basar. peshita! la tzericha, deit la shelacha, mahu detema battole mevattel la, ka mashma lan.
Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer koshrah kulei. peshita? la tzericha, deit la tarte issare, mahu detema

a: Chada minnayyhu battole mevattel, ka mashma lan. amar rav yosef amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi eliezer ben yaakov. amar leh abbaye: halacha, mikkelal difligi. amar leh: may nafka lach minna? amar leh: gemara gemor zemorta tehe?!
Mishna koshrin deli befasikya, aval lo bechevel. rabbi yehuda mattir. kelal amar rabbi yehuda: kol kesher sheeno shel kayyayma — en chayyayvin alav.

Gemara chevel demay? i lema chevel dealma, rabbi yehuda mattir? kesher shel kayyayma hu! ella chevel degardi. lememra derabbanan savri gazrinan chevel degardi attu chevel dealma, verabbi yehuda savar la gazrinan?
Ureminhu: chevel deli shennifsak lo yehe koshro ella onvo. verabbi yehuda omer: korech alav puneda o pasikya, uvilvad shello yaanvennu.
Kashya derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda, kashya derabbanan adderabbanan.

Derabbanan adderabbanan la kashya: chevel bechevel — michallaf. aniva bikshira — la michallefa. derabbi yehuda adderabbi yehuda la kashya: hatam — la mishshum demichallefa aniva bikshira, ella aniva gufah keshira hi.

Amar rabbi abba amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: mevi adam chevel mittoch beto, vekoshro bappara uvaevus etiveh rabbi acha aricha dehu rabbi acha bar pappa lerabbi abba: chevel shebbaevus — koshro bappara, veshebbappara — koshro baevus, uvilvad shello yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus! hatam — chevel dealma hacha chevel degardi.

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: kele kivvae muttar letaltelan beshabbat. beo minneh merav yehuda: koved haelyon vechoved hattachton mahu? in velav verafya bideh. ittemar amar rav nachman amar shemuel: kele kivvae muttar letaltelan beshabbat, afillu koved haelyon vechoved hattachton, aval lo et haammudim.

Amar leh rava lerav nachman: may shena ammudim dela? illema dekaaved gummot, gummot mimmela ka havyayn, ditnan: hattomen lefet utzenonot tachat haggefen, im miktzat alav megullin — eno choshesh lo mishshum kilayim, velo mishshum sheviit, velo mishshum maaser, venittalin beshabbat.

Besade — la ate leashvoye gummot, hacha bevayit — ate leashvoye gummot. bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yehuda bar levay: kele kivvae, kegon koved haelyon vechoved hattachton, mahu letaltelan beshabbat? amar leh: en metaltelin. ma taam? lefi sheen nittalin.

Mishna mekappelin et hakkelim afillu arbaa vachamishsha peamim, umatztziin et hammittot millele shabbat leshabbat, aval lo mishshabbat lemotzae shabbat. rabbi yishmael omer: mekappelin et hakkelim, umatztziin et hammittot miyyom hakkippurim leshabbat. vechelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, aval lo shel yom hakkippurim beshabbat. rabbi akiva omer: lo shel shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, velo shel yom hakkippurim kerevin beshabbat.

Gemara amri deve rabbi yannay: lo shanu ella beadam echad, aval bishne bene adam — lo. uveadam echad name la amaran ella bachadashim, aval bishanim — la. vochodashim name la amaran ella bilvanim, aval bitzvuim — la. vela amaran ella sheen lo lehachalif, aval yesh lo lehachalif — la.

Tana: shel bet rabban gamliel lo hayu mekappelim kele lavan shellahen, mippene shehaya lahen lehachalif. amar rav huna: im yesh lo lehachalif — yachalif, veim en lo lehachalif — yeshalshel bivgadav. matkif la rav safra: veha mitchaze keramut rucha. kevan dechol yoma la kaaved, vehaiddana hu deka aved — la mitchaze keramut rucha.

"Vechibbadto measot derachecha". "vechibbadto" — shello yehe malbushecha shel shabbat kemalbushecha shel chol, vechi ha derabbi yochanan kare lemaneh "mechabbedotay".
