"measot derachecha" — shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol. "mimmetzo cheftzecha" — chafatzecha asurin, cheftze shamayim muttarin. "vedabber davar" —
b: Shello yehe dibburecha shel shabbat kedibburecha shel chol. dibbur asur, hirhur — muttar. bishlama kullehu — lechayye, ella shello yehe hilluchecha shel shabbat kehilluchecha shel chol may hi? ki ha deamar rav huna amar rav, veamri leh amar rabbi abba amar rav huna: haya mehallech beshabbat ufaga beammat hammayim, im yachol lehanniach et raglo rishona kodem shetteaker sheniyya — muttar, veim lav — asur.

Matkif la rava: hechi lebed? laykkef — kamappesh behillucha. libar — zimnin demittavvevsan maneh mayya, veate lide sechita. ella beha kevan dela efshar — shappir dame. ella kediva minneh rabbi merabbi yishmael berabbi yose: mahu lifsoa pesia gassa beshabbat? amar leh: vechi bachol mi huttera? sheani omer: pesia gassa notelet echad mechamesh meot mimmeor enav shel adam. umahdar leh bekiddusha deve shimshe.

Bea minneh rabbi merabbi yishmael berabbi yose: mahu leechol adama beshabbat? amar leh: vechi bachol mi huttera? sheani omer: af bachol asur, mippene shehu malke. amar rabbi amme: kol haochel meafarah shel bavel — keillu ochel mibbesar avotav. veyesh omrim: keillu ochel shekatzim uremasim, dichtiv: "vayyimach et kol hayekum vegomer".

Amar resh lakish: lamma nikra shemah "shinar" — shekkol mete mabbul ninaru lesham. amar rabbi yochanan: lamma nikra shemah "metzula" — shekkol mete mabbul nitztallelu lesham. [veyesh omrim keillu ochel] shekatzim uremasim, veha vadday itmachoye itmachu! amri kevan demalke gezaru beh rabbanan. deha hahu gavra daachal gargishta vaachal tachle, ukedachu leh tachle belibbeh, umit.
"Verachatzt vasacht vesamt simlotayich" — amar rabbi elazar: ellu begadim shel shabbat. "ten lechacham veyechkam od" — amar rabbi elazar: zo rut hammoaviyya ushemuel haramati.

Rut, deillu noomi kaamra la "verachatzt vasacht vesamt simlotayich alayich veyaradt haggoren", veillu bedida ketiv: "vattered haggoren", vahadar "vattaas kechol asher tzivvatta chamotah". shemuel, deillu eli kaamar leh "shechav vehaya im yikra elecha veamarta dabber Adonai ki shomea avdecha", veillu bedideh ketiv beh: "vayyavo Adonai vayyityatztzav vayyikra chefaam befaam shemuel shemuel vayyomer shemuel dabber ki shomea avdecha", vela amar "dabber Adonai".

"Vattelech vattavo vattelakket bassade" — amar rabbi elazar: shehalcha uvat, halcha uvat, ad shemmatza bene adam hamehugganin leyelech immahem. "vayyomer boaz lenaaro hannitztzav al hakkotzrim lemi hannaara hazzot" — vechi darko shel boaz lishol benaara? amar rabbi elazar: devar chachma raa bah. shete shibbolin — loketet, shalosh shibbolin — enah loketet.

Bematnita tana: devar tzeniut raa bah, omdot — meummad, noflot — meyushshav. "vecho tidbakin im naarotay" — vechi darko shel boaz liddavek im hannashim? amar rabbi elazar: kevan dachaza "vattishshak orpa lachamotah verut davka bah", amar: shere leiddabboke bah.

"Vayyomer la voaz leet haochel goshi halom" — amar rabbi elazar, remez ramaz lah: atida malchut bet david latzet mimmech, dichtiv beh "halom", shenneemar: "vayyavo hammelech david vayyeshev lifne Adonai vayyomer mi anochi adonay Adonai umi veti ki havetani ad halom". "vetavalt pittech bachometz", amar rabbi elazar: mikkan shehachometz yafe lashsharav.

Rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: remez ramaz lah atid ben latzet mimmech shemmaasav kashin kachometz, umannu — menashshe. "vatteshev mitztzad hakkotzrim" — amar rabbi elazar: mitztzad hakkotzrim velo betoch hakkotzrim, remez ramaz lah sheatida malchut bet david shettitchallek.

"Vayyitzbot lah kali vattochal". amar rabbi elazar: "vattochal" — bime david, "vattisba" — bime shelomo, "vattotar" — bime chizkiyya. veikka deamri: "vattochal" — bime david uvime shelomo, "vattisba" — bime chizkiyya, "vattotar" — bime rabbi. deamar mar: ahureyareh derabbi hava attir mishshabbur malka. bematnita tana: "vattochal" — baolam hazze, "vattisba" — limot hammashiach, "vattotar" — leatid lavo.
"Vetachat kevodo yekad yekod kikod esh". amar rabbi yochanan: "vetachat kevodo", velo kevodo mammash. rabbi yochanan letameh, derabbi yochanan kare lemaneh "mechabbedotay".

Rabbi elazar omer: "vetachat kevodo" — tachat kevodo mammash. rabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: "tachat kevodo" — kisrefat bene aharon. ma lehallan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym, af kan serefat neshama veguf kayyaym.
Amar rabbi acha bar abba amar rabbi yochanan:

a: Minnayin leshinnuy begadim min hattora, shenneemar: "ufashat et begadav velavash begadim acherim", vetana deve rabbi yishmael, limmeda tora derech eretz: begadim shebbishshel bahen kedera lerabbo — al yimzog bahen kos lerabbo.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: genay hu letalmid chacham sheyyetze beminalim hametullaim lashshuk. veha rabbi acha bar chanina nafek! amar rabbi acha bereh derav nachman: bitlay al gav telay.

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol talmid chacham shennimtza revav al bigdo — chayyayv mita, shenneemar: "kol mesanay ahavu mavet" — al tikre "mesanay", ella "masniay". ravina amar: revad ittemar. vela peligi: ha biglima, ha bilvusha.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: may dichtiv "kaasher halach avdi yeshayahu arom veyachef". "arom" — bivgadim beluim, "veyachef" — beminalim hametullaim.

Tenan hatam: revav al hammardaat chotzetz. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ad keissar haitalki. veal habbegadim, mitztzad echad — eno chotzetz, mishshene tzedadin — chotzetz. rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabbi yishmael: af mitztzad echad chotzetz.

Bea minneh rabbi shimon ben lakish merabbi chanina: mardaat, mitztzad echad o mishshene tzedadin? amar leh: zo lo shamati, kayyotze bah shamati. ditnan rabbi yose omer: shel bannain — mitztzad echad, veshel bur — mishshene tzedadin. velo tehe mardaat chashuva mibbigdo shel am haaretz.

May "bannain"? amar rabbi yochanan: ellu talmide chachamim sheoskin bevinyano shel olam kol yemehen. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shemmachzirin lo aveda bitviut haayin — ze hammakpid al chaluko lehofcho. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shemmemannin oto parnas al hatztzibbur — ze sheshshoalin oto davar halacha bechol makom veomer, vaafillu bemassechet kalla.

Veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham shebbene iro metzuvvivyn laasot lo melachto — ze shemmanniach cheftzo veosek becheftze shamayim. vehane mille lemitrach berifteh. veamar rabbi yochanan: ezehu talmid chacham — kol sheshshoalin oto halacha bechol makom, veomrah. lemay nafka minna — lemannoyeh parnas al hatztzibbur. i bachada massechta — beatreh, i bechulleh tannoye — beresh metivta.

Rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: ellu kelim haolyayrin habbain mimmedinat hayyam. lememra dechivvare ninhu? vehaamar lehu rabbi yannay levanav: banay, al tikberuni lo bechelim levanim velo bechelim shechorim, levanim — shemma lo ezke, veehye kechatan ben avelim. shechorim — shema ezke, veehye keavel ben chatanim. ella bechelim haolyayrin habbain mimmedinat hayyam. alma, summake ninhu! la kashya: ha biglime, ha bilvushe.

Rabbi yishmael omer mekappelin kulei. tanu rabbanan: "olat shabbat beshabbatto", limmed al chelve shabbat shekkerevin beyom hakkippurim. yachol af shel yom hakkippurim beshabbat — talmud lomar: "beshabbatto", divre rabbi yishmael.
Rabbi akiva omer: "olat shabbat beshabbatto", limmed al chelve shabbat shekkerevim beyom tov. yachol af beyom hakkippurim — talmud lomar: "beshabbatto".

Keshettimtza lomar, ledivre rabbi yishmael nedarim unedavot kerevin beyom tov, vechi itzterich kera — leyom hakkippurim. ledivre rabbi akiva nedarim unedavot en kerevin beyom tov, vechi itzterich kera — lemishre beyom tov. amar rabbi zera:
b: Ki havena bevavel hava amrinan: ha detanya yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot erev shabbat — lo hayu tokin, uvemotzae shabbat — lo hayu mavdilin, divre hakkol hi. ki selekna lehatam, ashkechiteh lihuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi deyatev vekaamar: rabbi akiva hi, dei rabbi yishmael, kevan deamar chelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim, litka, ki hechi delehve yadi dechelve shabbat kerevin beyom hakkippurim. veamena leh ana: kohanim zerizin hen.

Amar leh mar kashshisha bereh derav chisda lerav ashe: mi amrinan kohanim zerizin hen? vehatnan: shalosh lehavetil et haam mimmelacha, shalosh lehavedil ben kodesh lechol. kedaamar abbaye: lishar amma devirushelem, hacha name lishar amma devirushelem.
Velitka, ki hechi deliddeu dishre biknivat yarak min hammincha ulemala. amar rav yosef: lefi sheen dochin shevut lehattir.
Verav shisha bereh derav idi amar: shevut kerova — hittiru, shevut rechoka — lo hittiru.

Ushevut kerova hittiru? vehatnan: yom tov shechal lihyot erev shabbat — tokin velo mavdilin. motzae shabbat — mavdilin velo tokin. veammay? litka, ki hechi deliddeu dishre bishchita lealtar! ella mechavvavrta kidrav yosef.

Amar rabbi zera amar rav huna, veamri la amar rabbi abba amar rav huna: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat — asur biknivat yarak. amar rav mana, tana: minnayin leyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat sheasur biknivat yarak — talmud lomar: "shabbaton", shevut. lemay? ilema limlacha — vehachtiv: "lo taase chol melacha"! ella lav, akkenivat yarak! shema minna.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat — muttar biknivat yarak. metivi: minnayin leyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat sheasur biknivat yarak — talmud lomar: "shabbaton", shevut. lemay? ilema limlacha — vehachtiv: "lo taase chol melacha" ella lav, biknivat yarak! la, leolam limlacha, velaavor aleha baase" velo taase".
Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: yom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat

a: Muttar biknivat yarak. (veamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: yom kippurim shechal lihyot bachol) mefatztzein beegozim umefarkesin berimmonim min hammincha ulemala mippene ogmat nefesh. deve rav yehuda mekannevi kerava. deve rabba gardi kare. kevan dachaza dahavo ka mecharfi, amar lehu: atay iggarta mimmareva mishshemeh derabbi yochanan daasir.
Haderan alach veellu kesharim

Mishna kol kitve hakkodesh matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ben shekkorin bahen, uven sheen korin bahen. af al pi shekketuvim bechol lashon, teunim geniza. umippene ma en korin bahem — mippene bittul bet hammidrash.

Gemara ittemar: hayu ketuvim targum o bechol lashon, rav huna amar: en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, verav chisda amar: matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka. allibba deman deamar nittenu likrot bahen — dechulle alma la peligi dematztzilin. ki peligi allibba deman deamar lo nittenu likrot bahen. rav huna amar: en matztzilin, deha lo nittenu likrot bahen. rav chisda: amar matztzilin mishshum bizyon kitve hakkodesh. tenan: kol kitve hakkodesh matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ben shekkorin bahen ben sheen korin bahen, af al pi shekketuvin bechol lashon. may lav, "shekkorin bahen" — neviim, "vesheen korin bahen" — ketuvim, "af al pi shekketuvin bechol lashon" — delo nittenu likrot bahen, vekatane: matztzilin, uteyuveta derav huna!

Amar lecha rav huna: vetisbera? ema sefa: teunin geniza — hasheta atztzole matztzillinan, geniza mibbee? ella, rav huna metaretz letameh, verav chisda metaretz letameh. rav huna metaretz letameh: "ben shekkorin bahem" — neviim, "uven sheen korin bahem" — ketuvim. bamme devarim amurim — shekketuvin bilshon hakkodesh, aval bechol lashon — en matztzilin, vaafillu hachi geniza bau. rav chisda metaretz letameh: "ben shekkorin bahen" — neviim, "uven sheen korin bahen" — ketuvim, af al pi shekketuvin bechol lashon, name matztzilin. vehachi kaamar: umekak shellahen teunin geniza.

Metivi: hayu ketuvim targum vechol lashon — matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka. teyuveta derav huna! amar lecha rav huna: hay tanna savar nittenu likrot bahen. ta shema: hayu ketuvin giftit, madit, ivrit, elamit, yevonit, af al pi shello nittenu likrot bahen — matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka. teyuveta derav huna! amar lecha rav huna: tannae hi, detanya: hayu ketuvin targum uvechol lashon — matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka. rabbi yose omer: en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka.

Amar rabbi yose: maase beabba chalafta shehalach etzel rabban gamliel beribbi litverya, umetzao shehaya yoshev al shulchano shel yochanan hannazuf uveyado sefer iyyov targum, vehu kore bo. amar lo: zachur ani berabban gamliel avi avicha shehaya omed al gabbe maala behar habbayit, veheviu lefanav sefer iyyov targum, veamar labbannay: shakkeehu tachat hannidbach. af hu tzivva alav ugenazo. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: areva shel tit kafu alav. amar rabbi, shete teshuvot baddavar: chada, vechi tit behar habbayit minnayin? veod, vechi muttar leabbedan bayyad? ella mannichan bimkom hatturepa vehen markivin mealehen. man tannae
b: Illema tanna kamma derabbi yose — vedilma beha kamippalgi, mar savar: nittenu likrot bahen, umar savar: lo nittenu likrot bahen. ella rabbi yose vetanna degiftit.

Tanu rabbanan: habberachot vehakkemein, af al pi sheyyesh bahen otiyyot shel shem umeinyaynot harebe shebbattora — en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ella nisrafim bimkoman [hen veazkarotehen]. mikkan amru: kotve verachot kesorfe tora. maase beechad shehaya kotev betzaydan, bau vehodiu et rabbi yishmael, vehalach rabbi yishmael levodko. keshehaya ole bassullam hirgish bo, natal tomos shel berachot veshikkean besefel shel mayim. uvallashon hazze amar lo rabbi yishmael: gadol onesh haacharon min harishon.

Bea minneh resh galuta merabba bar rav huna: hayu ketuvin besam uvesikra bekomos uvekankantom, bilshon hakkodesh, matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka o en matztzilin? tibbee leman deamar matztzilin, tibbee leman deamar en matztzilin. tibbee leman deamar en matztzilin — hane mille hecha dichtivi targum uvechol lashon, aval hacha dichtivi bilshon hakkodesh — matztzilin, o dilma afillu leman deamar matztzilin — hane mille hecha dichtivi bidyo demikkayyaym, aval hacha kevan dela mikkayyaym — la. amar leh: en matztzilin. veha rav hamenuna tana matztzilin! amar leh: i tanya — tanya. may tanya? amar rav ashe, kidtanya: en ben sefarim limgilla ella shehassefarim nichtavim bechol lashon, umegilla ad shettehe ketuva ashshurit, al hassefer, uvidyo.

Bea minneh rav huna bar chaluv merav nachman: sefer tora sheen bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kegon parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron", matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, o en matztzilin? amar leh: vetibbee lach parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron" gufa? hecha dechasar parashat "vayhi binsoa" — la kamibbaya li, dechevan deit beh hazekarot, af al gav delet beh shemonim vechamesh otiyyot — matztzilin. ki ka mibbaya li sefer tora sheen bo lelakket, may? amar leh: en matztzilin.

Etiveh: targum shekketavo mikra, umikra shekketavo targum, uchetav ivrit — matztzilin mippene haddeleka. veen tzarich lomar targum shebbeezra veshebbedaniel veshebbattora. targum shebbattora may nihu? — "yegar sahaduta", veaf al gav delet ba shemonim vechamesh otiyyot! ki tanya hahi — lehashelim.

Ibbaya lehu: hane shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, mechunnasot o mefuzzarot? rav huna amar: mechunnasot. rav chisda amar: afillu mefuzzarot. metivi: sefer tora shebbala, im yesh bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kegon parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron" — matztzilin, veim lav — en matztzilin. teyuveta derav huna! targema rav chisda allibba derav huna betevot.
Tanu rabbanan: "vayhi binsoa haaron vayyomer moshe" — parasha zo asa lah hakkadosh baruch hu simaniyyot millemala ulematta, lomar

a: Sheen ze mekomah. rabbi omer: lo min hashshem hu ze, ella mippene shessefer chashuv hu bifne atzmo.
Keman azla ha deamar rabbi shemuel bar nachman amar rabbi yonatan: "chatzva ammudeha shiva", ellu shiva sifre tora? — keman kerabbi.

Man tanna diflig aleh derabbi — rabban shimon ben gamliel hu. detanya: rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: atida parasha zo shetteaker mikkan vetikkatev bimkomah. velamma ketavah kan — kede lehafesik ben pureanut rishona lefureanut sheniyyay. pureanut sheniyyay may hi — "vayhi haam kemitonnim". pureanut rishona — "vayyisu mehar Adonai", veamar rabbi chama berabbi chanina: shessaru meachare Adonai. vehechan mekomah? amar rav ashe: baddegalim.

Ibbaya lehu: haggilyonin shel sefer tora, matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka o en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka? ta shema: sefer tora shebbala, im yesh bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kegon parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron" — matztzilin, veim lav en matztzilin. veammay, tippok leh mishshum gillayon dideh! bala shane.

Ta shema: sefer tora shennimchak, im yesh bo lelakket shemonim vechamesh otiyyot, kegon parashat "vayhi binsoa haaron" — matztzilin, veim lav — en matztzilin, veammay? tippok leh mishshum gillayon dideh! mekom hakketav la kamibbaya li, dechi kadosh — aggav ketav hu dekadosh, azal ketav — azala la kedusheteh. ki kamibbaya li shel mala veshel matta, shebben parasha lefarasha, shebben daf ledaf, shebbitchillat hassefer, shebbesof hassefer. vetippok leh mishshum hahu! degiz ushede.
Ta shema: haggilyonin shel mala veshel matta, shebben parasha lefarasha, shebben daf ledaf, shebbitchillat hassefer, shebbesof hassefer — metammein et hayyadayim! dilma aggav sefer tora shane.

Ta shema: haggilyonin vesifre minin en matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, ella nisrafin bimkoman hen veazkarotehen. may lav, gilyonin desefer tora? la, gilyonin desifre minin. hasheta sifre minin gufayyhu en matztzilin, gilyonin mibbaya? hachi kaamar: vesifre minin hare hen kegilyonim.

Gufa: haggilyonim vesifre minin en matztzilin otam mippene haddeleka. rabbi yose omer: bachol koder et haazkarot shebbahen vegonzan, vehashshear — sorfan. amar rabbi tarfon: akappeach et banay, sheim yavou leyadi sheani esrof otam veet haazkarot shebbahen. sheafillu adam rodef acharav lehorgo, venachash ratz lehakkisho, nichnas levet avoda zara veen nichnas levattehen shel ellu, shehallalu makkirin vechofrin, vehallalu en makkirin vechofrin. vaalehen hakkatuv omer: "achar haddelet vehammezuza samt zichronech".

Amar rabbi yishmael, kal vachomer: uma laasot shalom ben ish leishto amra tora: shemi shennichtav bikdushsha yimmache al hammayim, hallalu shemmetilin kina veeva vetacharut ben yisrael laavihen shebbashshamayim — al achat kamma vechamma. vaalehem amar david: "halo mesanecha Adonai esna uvitkommecha etkotat tachlit sina senetim leoyvim hayu li". ucheshem sheen matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka, kach en matztzilin otan lo min hammappolet velo min hammayim velo middavar hameabbedan.

Bae minneh yosef bar chanin merabbi avahu: hane sifre deve avidan, matztzilin otan mippene haddeleka o en matztzilin? in velav verafya bideh. rav la azel leve avidan, vechol shekken leve nitzrefe. shemuel leve nitzrefe la azel, leve avidan azel. amaru leh lerava: may tama la atet leve avidan? amar lehu: dikla pelanya ikka beorcha, vekashe li. nikereh. ducheteh kashe li. mar bar yosef amar: ana minnayyhu ana, vela mistefena minnayyhu. zimna chada azal, beo lesakkoneh. rabbi meir hava kare leh "avevn gilyon". rabbi yochanan hava kare leh "avon gilyon".
Imma shalom, devethu derabbi eliezer, achateh derabban gamliel havay. hava hahu filosfa beshivavuteh
b: Dahava shekil shema dela mekabbel shucheda. beo leachoche beh. ayyayla leh sheraga dedahava, vaazul lekammeh. amara leh: baena deniflegu li benichse deve nashay. amar lehu: pelugu. amar leh, ketiv lan: bimkom bera, beratta la terot. amar leh: min yoma diglitun mearachon, itnetilat orayyta demoshe veitiyhivat avon gilyon, uchetiv beh: bera uveratta kachada yirtun.

Lemachar hadar ayyel leh ihu chamara luva. amar lehu: shefilit lesefeh daavon gilyon, uchetiv beh: ana la lemifchat min orayyta demoshe ateti [vela] leosofe al orayyta demoshe ateti, uchetiv beh: bimkom bera — beratta la terot. amara leh: nehor nehoraych kishraga. amar leh rabban gamliel: ata chamra uvetash lishraga.

Umippene ma en korin kulei. amar rav: lo shanu ella bizman bet hammidrash, aval shello bizman bet hammidrash — korin. ushemuel amar: afillu shello bizman bet hammidrash en korin. ini?! veha nehardea atreh dishmuel hava, uvinhardea paski sidra bichtuvim beminchata deshabbeta. ella i ittemar, hachi ittemar — amar rav: lo shanu ella bimkom bet hammidrash. aval shello bimkom bet hammidrash — korin.

Ushemuel amar: ben bimkom bet hammidrash ben shello bimkom bet hammidrash, bizman bet hammidrash — en korin, shello bizman bet hammidrash — korin. veazda shemuel letameh, devinhardea paski sidra dichtuvim beminchata deshabbeta.

Rav ashe amar: leolam kedaamaran meikkara, ushemuel kerabbi nechemya. detanya: af al pi sheamru kitve hakkodesh en korin bahen — aval shonin bahen vedorshin bahen. nitzrach lefasuk — mevi veroe bo. amar rabbi nechemya: mippene ma amru kitve hakkodesh en korin bahen — kede sheyyomru: bechitve hakkodesh en korin, vechol shekken beshitre hedyotot.
Mishna matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer, vetik hattefillin im hattefillin, veaf al pi sheyyesh betochan maot. ulehechan matztzilin otan — lemavoy sheeno mefullash. ben betera omer: af limfullash.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat, mafshitin et happesach ad hechaze — divre rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka. vachachamim omrim: mafshitin et kullo. bishlama lerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka, deha itavid leh tzorech gavoah. ella lerabbanan may tama? amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan, deamar kera: "kol paal Adonai lammaanehu". vehacha, may "lemaanehu" ikka? rav yosef amar: shello yasriach. rava amar: shello yehu kodshe shamayim mutalin kinvela.

May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu demannach appatura dedahava, i name yoma deistana. verabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka, hay "paal Adonai lammaanehu" may aved leh? shello yotzi et haemurin kodem hafeshatat haor. may tama? amar rav huna bereh derav natan: mishshum nimin.

Amar rav chisda amar mar ukeva: may ahdaru leh chavrayyay lerabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka? hachi kaamri leh: im matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer, lo nafshit et happesach meoro? mi dame?! hatam — tiltul, hacha — melacha! amar rav ashe: betarte peligi, peligi betiltul ufeligi bimlacha, vehachi kaamri leh: im matztzilin tik hassefer im hassefer, lo netaltel or aggav basar?!

a: Mi dame?! hatam — naasa basis ledavar hammuttar, hacha — naasa basis ledavar haasur! ella hachi kaamri leh: im matztzilin tik shel sefer im hassefer, veaf al pi sheyyesh betocho maot, lo netaltel or aggav basar?! mi dame? hatam naasa basis ledavar haasur uledavar hammuttar, hacha — kullo naasa basis ledavar haasur. ella hachi kaamri leh: im meviin tik sheyyesh betocho maot mealma lehatztzil bo sefer tora, lo netaltel or aggav basar?!

Vehi gufah menalan? illema demiddehecha deit beh la shade lehu, etoye name mayytinan — mi dame?! hatam — addehachi vehachi nafla deleka, hacha — addehacha vehachi lishdinhu. ella amar mar bar rav ashe: leolam kidamrinan meikkara. udeka kashya lach: hacha tiltul vehacha melacha — kegon dela kavae leh leor.
Veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut" — deshakel leh bevarze.

Ulehechan matztzilin otan vechulei. hechi dame mefullash, hechi dame sheeno mefullash? amar rav chisda: shalosh mechitztzot ushene lechayayin — zehu mavoy sheeno mefullash. shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad — zehu mavoy hamefullash. vetarvayyhu allibba derabbi eliezer, ditnan: hechsher mavoy — bet shammay omrim: lechi vekora, uvet hillel omrim: o lechi o kora. rabbi eliezer omer: shene lechayayim.

Amar leh rabba: shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad "mefullash" karet leh? veod, lerabbanan natztzil letocho ochalin umashkin! ella amar rabba: shete mechitztzot ushene lechayayin — zehu mavoy sheeno mefullash. shete mechitztzot velechi echad — zehu mavoy hamefullash.

Vetarvayyhu allibba derabbi yehuda. detanya, yater al ken amar rabbi yehuda: mi sheyyesh lo shene vattim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim — ose lechi mikkan velechi mikkan, o kora mikkan vekora mikkan, venose venoten baemtza. amru lo: en mearvin reshut harabbim bechach.
Amar leh abbaye: ledidach name, lerabbanan natztzil letocho ochalin umashkin?
b: Ella amar rav ashe: shalosh mechitztzot velechi echad — ze mavoy sheeno mefullash. shalosh mechitztzot belo lechi — zehu mavoy hamefullash. vaafillu lerabbi eliezer deamar baenan lechayayim, hane mille laochalin umashkin, aval lesefer tora — bechad lechi saggi.

Mishna matztzilin mazon shalosh seudot. harauy laadam — laadam, harauy labbehema — labbehema. ketzad? nafla deleka belele shabbat — matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot. bashshacharit — matztzilin mezon shete seudot. bammincha — mezon seuda achat. rabbi yose omer: leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot.

Gemara mikkede behettera katarach, natztzel tefe? amar rava: mittoch sheadam bahul al mamono, i sharet leh — ate lechabboye. amar leh abbaye, ella ha detanya: nishbera lo chavit berosh gaggo — mevi keli umanniach tachteha, uvilvad shello yavi keli acher veyiklot, keli acher vitzaref. hatam, may gezera ikka? hacha name, gezera shemma yavi keli derech reshut harabbim.

Gufa: nishbera lo chavit berosh gaggo — mevi keli umanniach tachteha, uvilvad shello yavi keli acher veyiklot, keli acher vitzaref. nizdammenu lo orchin — mevi keli acher vekolet, keli acher umetzaref. velo yiklot veachar kach yazmin, ella yazmin veachar kach yiklot. veen maarimin bechach, mishshum rabbi yose bar yehuda amru: maarimin.

Lema biflugeta derabbi eliezer verabbi yehoshua kamippalgi? detanya: oto veet beno shennaflu levor? — rabbi eliezer omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto, vehashsheni ose lo parnasa bimkomo bishvil shello yamut. rabbi yehoshua omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto veeno shochato, umaarim umaale et hashsheni — ratza ze shochet, ratza ze shochet.

Mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam, deefshar befarnasa, aval hacha dela efshar — la. vead kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam, mishshum deikka tzaar baale chayyim, aval hacha delekka tzaar baale chayyim — la.

Tanu rabbanan: hitztzil pat nekiyya — en matztzil pat haderaa, pat haderaa — matztzil pat nekiyya. umatztzilin miyyom hakkippurim lashshabbat, aval lo mishshabbat leyom hakkippurim. veen tzarich lomar mishshabbat leyom tov, velo mishshabbat lashshabbat habbaa.

Tanu rabbanan: shachach pat battannur vekiddesh alav hayyom — matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot, veomer laacherim: bou vehatztzilu lachem. ucheshehu rode, lo yirde bemarde, ella besakkin. ini?! veha tana deve rabbi yishmael: "lo taase chol melacha", yatza tekiat shofar urediyyayt happat shehi chachma veenah melacha? kamma deefshar leshannoye meshannenan.

Amar rav chisda: leolam yashkim adam lehotzaat shabbat, shenneemar: "vehaya bayyom hashshishshi vehechinu et asher yaviu", lealtar. amar rabbi abba: beshabbat chayyayv adam livtzoa al shete chikkarot, dichtiv: "lechem mishne".

Amar rav ashe: chazena leh lerav kahana denaket tarte uvatza chada. amar: "laktu" ketiv. rabbi zera hava batza akkulla sheruteh. amar leh ravina lerav ashe: veha michze keraavtanuta? amar leh: kevan dechol yoma la aved, vehaiddana hu dekaaved — la michze keraavtanuta. rabbi amme verabbi assi ki mikkela lehu rifta deeruva — sharu illaveh, amri: hoil veitavid ba chada mitzva — litavid ba mitzva acharina.

Ketzad? nafla deleka kulei. tanu rabbanan: kamma seudot chayyayv adam leechol bashshabbat — shalosh. rabbi chidka omer: arba. amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehem mikra echad darshu: "vayyomer moshe ichluhu hayyom ki shabbat hayyom laAdonai hayyom lo timtzauhu bassade". rabbi chidka savar: hane telata "hayyom" levar meureta, verabbanan savri: bahade deureta. tenan: nafla deleka belele shabbat

a: Matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot, may lav — dela achal! la, daachal. shacharit matztzilin mezon shete seudot, may lav — dela achal? la, daachal. bemincha matztzilin mezon seuda achat, may lav — dela achal? la, daachal!
Veha middekatane sefa: rabbi yose omer leolam matztzilin mezon shalosh seudot — mikkelal detanna kamma shalosh sevira leh! ella mechavvavrta, matnitin dela kerabbi chidka.

Veha ditnan: mi sheyyesh lo mezon shete seudot — lo yittol min hattamchuy, mezon arba esre — lo yittol min hakkuppa. manni? la rabbanan, vela rabbi chidka. i rabbanan — chamsere havyayn. i rabbi chidka — shet sere havyayn! leolam rabbanan, deamrinan leh: may devaet lemechal beappoke shabbeta, ichleh beshabbeta.

Lema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi chidka. afillu tema rabbi chidka, deamrinan leh: may devaet lemechal bemaale shabbeta, ichleh leureta. vechulle yoma demaale shabbeta betaanita motvinan leh?! ella ha manni — rabbi akiva hi, deamar: ase shabbattecha chol veal titztarech labberiyyot.

Veha ditnan: en pochatin leani haover mimmakom lemakom mikkikkar befunedyon mearba sein besela. lan — notnin lo parnasat lina, veim shavat — notnin lo mezon shalosh seudot. lema rabbanan hi, vela rabbi chidka? leolam rabbi chidka — kegon deikka seuda bahadeh, deamrinan leh: ha deikka bahadach — ichleh. vechi azel berekan azel?! dimlavvivynan leh seuda bahadeh. may parnasat lina? amar rav pappa: pureya uve sadya.

Tanu rabbanan: kearot sheachal bahen arvit — maddichan leechol bahen shacharit. shacharit — maddichan leechol bahen batztzohorayim. batztzohorayim — maddichan leechol bahen bammincha. min hammincha veelach — shuv eno maddiach. aval kosot vekitoniyyot utzelochiyyot — maddiach veholech kol hayyom kullo, lefi sheen keva lishtiyya.

Amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi mishshum bar kappara: kol hamekayyem shalosh seudot beshabbat nitztzol mishshalosh pureaniyyot: mechevlo shel mashiach, umiddinah shel gehinnam, umimmilchemet gog umagog. mechevlo shel mashiach — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "hinne anochi sholeach lachem et eliyya hannavi lifne bo yom vegomer". middinah shel gehinnam — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "yom evra hayyom hahu". mimmilchemet gog umagog — ketiv hacha "yom", uchetiv hatam: "beyom bo gog".
Amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi yose: kol hameanneg et hashshabbat notnin lo nachala beli metzarim, shenneemar: "az titannag al Adonai vehirkavticha al bomote aretz vehaachalticha
b: Nachalat yaakov avicha vegomer". lo keavraham, shekkatuv bo "kum hithallech baaretz leorkah vegomer". velo keyitzchak, shekkatuv bo "ki lecha ulezaracha etten et kol haaratzot hael". ella keyaakov, shekkatuv bo "ufaratzta yamma vakedma vetzafona vanegba".

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: nitztzol mishshibud galiyyot. ketiv hacha: "vehirkavtich al bomote aretz", uchetiv hatam: "veatta al bamotemo tidroch". amar rav yehuda amar rav: kol hameanneg et hashshabbat notnin lo mishalot libbo, shenneemar: "vehitannag al Adonai veyitten lecha mishalot libbecha". oneg ze eni yodea mahu. keshehu omer "vekarata lashshabbat oneg" — heve omer ze oneg shabbat. bamme meannego? rav yehuda bereh derav shemuel bar shilat mishshemeh derav amar: betavshil shel teradin vedagim gedolim verashe shumin. rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: afillu davar muat, velichvod shabbat asao — hare ze oneg. may hi? amar rav pappa: kasa deharsana.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hameshammer shabbat kehilchato, afillu oved avoda zara [kedor] enosh — mochalin lo, shenneemar: "ashre enosh yaase zot vegomer mechallelo". al tikre "mechallelo" ella: "machul lo".

Amar rav yehuda amar rav: ilmale shamru yisrael shabbat rishona lo shalta bahen umma velashon, shenneemar: "vayhi bayyom hashshevii yatzu min haam lilkot", uchetiv batreh: "vayyavo amalek". amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay: ilmale meshammerin yisrael shete shabbatot kehilchatan — miyyad nigalim, shenneemar: "cho amar Adonai lassarisim asher yishmeru et shabbetotay", uchetiv batreh: "vahaviotim el har kodshi vegomer".

Amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki meochle shalosh seudot bashshabbat. amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki miggomre hallel bechol yom. ini?! vehaamar mar: hakkore hallel bechol yom hare ze mecharef umegaddef! ki kaamrinan — bifsuke dezimra.

Amar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmitpallelim im dimdume chamma. amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: mitzva lehitpallel im dimdume chamma. amar rabbi zera, may kera: "yiraucha im shamesh velifne yareach dor dorim".

Veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmete becholi meayim, daamar mar: rubban shel tzaddikim metim becholi meayim. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmete bederech mitzva. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmachnise shabbat bitverya, umimmotzie shabbat betzippori. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmoshive bet hammidrash, velo mimmaamide bet hammidrash.
Veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki miggabbay tzedaka vela mimmechalleke tzedaka. veamar rabbi yose: yehe chelki mimmi shechoshdin oto veen bo. amar rav pappa: ledidi chashdun vela hava bi.

Amar rabbi yose: chamesh beilot baalti, venatati chamishsha arazim beyisrael. uman innun — rabbi yishmael berabbi yose, verabbi elazar berabbi yose, verabbi chalafta berabbi yose, verabbi avtilas berabbi yose, verabbi menachem berabbi yose. vehaikka vardimas! hayeynu vardimas hayeynu menachem, veammay kare leh "vardimas"? — sheppanav domin levered. lememra derabbi yose mitzvat ona lo kiyyem?! ella ema: chamesh beilot baalti veshaniti.
Amar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo kariti leishti "ishti" uleshori "shori", ella leishti — "beti", uleshori — "sadi".

Amar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo nistakkalti bammilla shelli. ini? vehaamaru leh lerabbi: may tama karu lach rabbenu hakkadosh? amar lehu: miyyamay lo nistakkalti bammilla shelli. berabbi milleta achariti hava beh, shello hichnis yado tachat avneto. veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo rau korot beti imre chaluki.

Veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo avarti al divre chaveray. yodea ani beatzmi sheeni kohen, im omrim li chaveray: ale ladduchan — ani ole. veamar rabbi yose: miyyamay lo amarti davar vechazarti laachoray.

Amar rav nachman: tete li, dekayyemit shalosh seudot beshabbat. amar rav yehuda: tete li, dekayyemit iyyun tefilla. amar rav huna bereh derav yehoshua: tete li, dela sagena arba ammot begilluy harosh. amar rav sheshet: tete li, dekayyemit mitzvat tefillin. veamar rav nachman: tete li, dekayyemit mitzvat tzitzit.

Amar leh rav yosef lerav yosef bereh derabba: avuch, bemay zehir tefe? amar leh: betzitzit. yoma chad hava ka salek bedarga. ippesik leh chuta, vela nechet vaata, kamma dela ramya. veamar abbaye: tete li, dechi chazena tzureba merabbanan dishlim massechteh
